title: Técnica de Confiabilidade de Ativos III (Afirmativa para Mulheres)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Padronizar, orientar e executar a manutenção preventiva e corretiva em equipamentos primários, proteção, automação e controle além de propor ações visando a redução de custos operacionais e alternativas para desenvolver soluções de problemas para melhorias no processo.
  • Padronizar, orientar e executar atividades de manutenções preventivas e corretivas nos sistemas de comando, controle, proteção, telecomunicações e leitura e interpretação de diagramas e desenhos funcionais.
  • Realizar a operação local das instalações sobre sua responsabilidade sempre que necessário.
  • Conduzir a fiscalização, diagnóstico e análise das condições dos equipamentos das instalações, realizando inspeções periódicas.
  • Atuar no planejamento, e programação dos serviços de manutenção, instruindo e emitindo as solicitações de intervenção bem como controlar os serviços de manutenção programados e executados, através do sistema de gestão vigente, criando, gerindo, acompanhando e encerrando Notas de Manutenção.
  • Conhecer, difundir e aplicar os procedimentos e normas técnicas, ambientais e de Segurança do Trabalho vigentes na empresa.
  • Apoiar as atividades relacionadas a implantação de projetos de reforços e melhorias, bem como nos serviços de comissionamento de novas instalações e equipamentos.
  • Analisar eventos emergenciais e preventivos e propor soluções de manutenção e adequações no plano para mitigar risco de novos eventos.
  • Disponibilizar a programação de escalas de trabalho e/ou férias pré-estabelecidas pela Coordenação, mantendo a fluidez das atividades de operação e manutenção.
  • Substituir o demais Técnicos de Confiabilidade de Ativos nas ausências em decorrência de afastamentos, férias, treinamentos ou outras situações necessárias.
  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento das instalações e processos, identificando lacunas técnicas e propondo melhorias
  • Cumprir o regulamento, políticas, instruções e regulamentações internas e externas, participar e receber orientações dos temas de anticorrupção, antissuborno e compliance, as normas de saúde, higiene e segurança do trabalho, sistemas de gestão da qualidade e preservação ambiental, bem como a utilização de EPI's/EPC's (Equipamento de proteção individual/ Coletivo) quando a atividade assim o exigir. Controlar os indicadores de performance da área, proceder à análise dos relatórios das áreas sob sua responsabilidade, analisando os indicadores de performance e demonstrativo de objetivos X resultados alcançados e estabelecendo correções, revisões de estratégias e reorientando, se for o caso, o processo de trabalho
  • Dirigir veículos, quando necessário, desde que devidamente habilitado e autorizado, como condição necessária e obrigatória para execução de atribuições pertinentes ao seu cargo, bem como desenvolver outras atividades inerentes ao cargo ou a critério de seu superior imediato, desde que habilitado e estejam de acordo com o seu conhecimento e experiência.

Requisitos e qualificações

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ?

  • Formação Técnica em Eletrotécnica, Eletrônica, Eletromecânica, Eletroeletrônica, Mecânica, ou área afim.
  • CTF ativo
  • Conhecimentos e atuação em Normas e Procedimentos de Segurança em Energia Elétrica e Sistema; Equipamentos primários de Subestação, sistemas de proteção controle, automação e telecomunicações; Equipamentos especiais (máquinas síncronas, FACTS); Conhecimentos em rotinas de manutenção;

title: Senior Art Director
description:
About Keeta

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan , a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.” Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. With over 1,000 team members around the world , Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!

Know more: Keeta Website

Location : 100% on site - Vila Olimpia, SP

Please submit your resume in English.

We are seeking an Art Director to join our Branding team and play a pivotal role in crafting creative ads and evolving the visual presence of our brand in Brazil. This position is crucial to ensuring that our campaigns are visually striking and culturally resonant, helping us establish a strong foothold in the Brazilian market. If you are passionate about creating captivating visuals and have experience leading high-level creative projects, we want to hear from you!

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute the creative visual concepts for entire campaigns, working closely with the content team.
  • Create impactful key visuals that align with the company's marketing strategies.
  • Create high-conversion ad creatives—such as short videos, image-text formats, interactive ads, and H5 pages—based on user psychology, industry trends, and market hot topics.
  • Lead the development and localization of the brand in Brazil, adapting it to the cultural and aesthetic context of the country.
  • Guide and lead other design team members in various projects, ensuring visual consistency and excellence.
  • Design materials for different channels, including digital media, social networks, websites, print materials, and Out Of Home (OOH) media.
  • Manage the creative process from conception to final production, maintaining deadlines and quality standards.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure visual guidelines align with brand objectives.
  • Stay updated with design trends, technology, and industry innovations, applying relevant insights to projects.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above, preferably in Marketing, Advertising, Visual Design, Journalism, or related fields;
  • Strong business English communication skills;
  • Proven experience as an Art Director or similar role in crafting visual campaigns and key visuals;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing strategic creative skills and visual aesthetics;
  • Experience in leading and mentoring design teams and collaborating with content strategists;
  • In-depth knowledge of Brazilian culture, aesthetics, and market trends;
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in dynamic environments;
  • Proficiency in design software and visual creation tools;
  • Excellent communication skills and a strong ability to work as part of a team.

title: PESSOA COORDENADORA HRBP
description:
Somos o grupo educacional mais diversificado do país. Todos os dias, criamos futuros incríveis através da inovação. Colocamos a mão na massa para tirar as ideias do papel e colocá-las em prática. Enfrentamos desafios com resiliência e nos adaptamos às mudanças constantes.

Por aqui, somos um time e não heróis, guiados pela vontade de fazer a diferença e conectados de um só jeito, o #JeitoCogna. Nossa relação é direta e respeitosa, e o sucesso dos nossos alunos e clientes é o nosso sucesso.

Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.

  • Conduzir iniciativas de desenvolvimento organizacional, incluindo programas de liderança, planejamento de sucessão e gestão de mudança.

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.

Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.

  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.

Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Sales Manager
description:
With an annual turnover of USD 6 billion, DELI Group is the largest office stationery manufacturer in China. We are also a hardware and tools leader in China. We have got succeed in different fields, including office stationery, tools, office furniture, sports, etc.

More than 40 years' experience makes us clearly know how to satisfy customers' requirements of office supplies. Deli established its own research and development centers. In addition to advanced production and design technology, Deli also implements a strict quality control system, overseeing each step, from raw material to production lines.

Until now, we have more than 100 branches company in China, and 8 overseas regional office and 18 branch offices which covering 5 continents with more than 150 countries. We work with more than 5000 distributors and 50,000 Retailers in the world.

Deli oversea Website:

Deli Tools Website:

O Analista Técnico de Data center é o principal responsável pela Infraestrutura Crítica do Data Center, mantendo o correto funcionamento de todos os equipamentos do ambiente e fornecendo suporte local para os demais grupos, como: especialistas e equipes de gerenciamento.

  • Leituras/Medições para controle e planejamento de aumento ou distribuição de carga (Análise de capacidade);
  • Analisar e fazer a gestão de tickets abertos nas ferramentas de ITSM;

Nível técnico completo – Eletrotécnico.

Competências:

  • Senso crítico e analítico para lidar com atividades em um ambiente de missão crítica. Atenção aos detalhes para detectar anomalias no ambiente.

  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal para trabalhar em equipe orientando e também recebendo orientações, forte senso de organização e responsabilidade;
  • Conhecimento de sistemas de infraestrutura de Data Center (instalações elétricas em geral AC e DC, grupos geradores, ar-condicionado, extinção de incêndio, sistemas retificadores, UPSs, baterias e painéis de distribuição.).

Experiência Profissional:

Sólida Experiência em manutenção de sistemas de infraestrutura crítica e sistemas de distribuição elétrica em ambiente de Data Center ou instalações similares.

Inglês e espanhol básico.

DC SAO1 Cotia/SP.

Presencial em escala 4x2.

title: M365 & IAM Engineer
description:
We never ask for payment as part of our selection process, and we always contact candidates via our corporate accounts and platforms. If you are approached for payment, this is likely to be fraudulent. Please check to see whether the role you are interested in is posted on our career website.

About TMF Group

TMF Group is a leading provider of critical administrative services, helping clients invest and operate safely around the world. We provide legal, financial, and employee administration through TMF Group’s teams in 120 offices.

Our 9,100 experts and 120 offices in 85 jurisdictions worldwide serve corporates, financial institutions, asset managers, private clients and family offices, providing the combination of accounting, tax, payroll, fund administration, compliance and entity management services essential to global business success.

We help businesses achieve global compliance, transparency and consistency.

Discover the Role

We are seeking a skilled and proactive M365 and IAM Engineer to manage, secure, and optimize our Microsoft 365 environment and Identity & Access Management systems , On-Prem and Azure Active directory , Pas Services.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with M365 services, Azure Active Directory, and IAM tools, ensuring secure and seamless access to enterprise resources.

Key Responsibilities

Microsoft 365 Administration:

- Manage and support M365 services including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive, and Intune.

- Team Telephony

- Implement and maintain M365 security and compliance features (DLP, ATP, Conditional Access, etc.).

- Monitor service health, usage, and performance; troubleshoot and resolve issues.

- Automate tasks using PowerShell scripting.

Identity & Access Management (IAM):

- Administer and maintain Azure Active Directory (AAD), including user provisioning, SSO, MFA, and conditional access policies.

- Integrate IAM solutions with cloud and on-prem applications.

- Manage lifecycle of user identities and access rights across systems.

- Conduct regular access reviews and audits to ensure compliance.

- ADFS

Security & Compliance:

- Collaborate with security teams to enforce identity governance and data protection policies.

- Respond to security incidents related to identity and access.

- Ensure compliance with regulatory standards

Key Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.

- 3–5 years of experience in M365 administration and IAM.

- Strong knowledge of Azure AD, Active Directory, and M365 security features.

- Experience with IAM tools

- Excellent troubleshooting and communication skills.

Preferred Certifications:

- Microsoft Certified: Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals

What’s in it for you?

Pathways for career development

  • Work with colleagues and clients around the world on interesting and challenging work.
  • We provide internal career opportunities, so you can take your career further within TMF.
  • Continuous development is supported through global learning opportunities from the TMF Business Academy.

Making an impact

  • You’ll be helping us to make the world a simpler place to do business for our clients.
  • Through our corporate social responsibility program, you’ll also be making a difference in the communities where we work.

A supportive environment

  • Strong feedback culture to help build an engaging workplace.
  • Regardless of where you are in your career, TMF Group opens a world of opportunity where you will be part of our team and is supported in your global career journey.
  • Our inclusive work environment allows you to work from our offices around the world, as well as from home, helping you find the right work-life balance to perform at your best.
  • At TMF Group, it’s our people who make us who we are. Our company thrives on entrepreneurial spirit and is full of proactive people who combine enthusiasm with responsibility and accountability.

Other Benefits

  • Anniversary & Birthday Leave policy
  • Be part of One TMF
  • Paternity & Adoption leaves
  • Salary advance policy
  • Work flexibility – Hybrid work model
  • Talk about growth opportunities (we invest in talent)
  • Well-being initiatives

We’re looking forward to getting to know you!

title: CTO
description:
Já imaginou ser sócio da Tangram, nomeada a melhor plataforma de Educação Financeira do Brasil?

Se educação faz os seus olhos brilharem , esta oportunidade pode ser para você.

Mas, se você não tiver perfil empreendedor , garra para trabalhar muito e aceitar ganhar menos no curto prazo, melhor nem perdermos tempo.

Na tangram, nossa missão é tornar as pessoas mais ricas. E não falo só de dinheiro.

Dezenas de milhares de estudantes de todos os estados do Brasil já utilizaram nossa plataforma.

Este ano, nosso app ficou entre os 20 mais baixados na categoria Educação da App Store.

Fomos a única solução de Educação Financeira escolhida e financiada pela Fundação Itaú para implementar funcionalidades com IA em escolas públicas.

Queremos melhorar a experiência de aprendizagem dos estudantes, e a tecnologia é fundamental para tornar isso possível.

Aprender deve ser envolvente e acessível, para todos.

Desde que fundamos a Tangram, estivemos muito focados em criar um bom produto. Alunos se tornaram fãs. Professores, evangelizadores.

Desde 2022, todas as escolas particulares que adotaram o nosso programa continuam. Zero churn.

Nas vendas para o setor público, conseguimos expandir um contrato para milhares de estudantes.

Fizemos tudo isso sem investimento externo, com um time de apenas 3 desenvolvedores.

Começamos. Agora é hora de escalar. Você é essa pessoa para fazer isso acontecer?

Estamos em busca de um desenvolvedor com conhecimento full stack, experiência em infraestrutura AWS e algum domínio em IA, disposto a colocar a mão na massa em nossa stack - Node.js, React, React Native e PostgreSQL e com habilidades para liderar um time maior nos próximos anos.

Buscamos alguém fora da curva e a fim de trabalhar muito - porque o sonho aqui é grande.

Se você tiver experiência no setor educacional, ótimo. Mas eu priorizo alguém com muita fome e ambição para construir.

O trabalho é remoto, então, você pode estar em qualquer lugar do Brasil.

title: HR Business Partner (individual contributor position)
description:
Hi there! Thanks for your curiosity

We’re driven by ambition and guided by a bold vision for the years ahead. As we scale our profitable ecosystem of tools and services, we’re seeking a dedicated and adaptable HR Business Partner – Brazil (individual contributor position) to help us bring our People strategy to life and support our teams on the ground.

In this position, you will report directly to the Director of People and work closely with leaders and employees to ensure that People processes run efficiently and consistently. This is an individual contributor role with a strong execution component — combining hands-on delivery with collaboration and influence across regional and global teams.

Who we are

Zubale is a technology company that enables retailers to win in eCommerce. We serve a wide range of retailers — from supermarkets, specialty stores, pharmacies, and department stores to fashion brands — across Mexico, Brazil, Chile, Costa Rica, Peru, and Colombia.

We have three key products:

  1. Flexifleet – Freelancer Marketplace to perform picking, packing, and delivery tasks for retailers and aggregators.
  2. Fulfillment Optimizer – Modular Software to increase productivity in eCommerce picking, packing, and delivery.
  3. Consumer Connect – AI WhatsApp Conversational Commerce to boost sales and elevate customer experience.

We are passionate about helping brands, aggregators, and retailers optimize their eCommerce operations, lower costs, and boost profitability.

Backed by over USD 70 million in venture capital , we’ve delivered consistent growth and completed 100+ million orders through our platform. Today, we serve 100+ customers and engage thousands of freelancers across Latin America — and this is just the beginning.

Who you are

You are a hands-on HR professional who enjoys being close to the business and the people. You combine empathy, structure, and a strong sense of ownership to deliver high-quality results.

You thrive in dynamic environments, balancing operational priorities with thoughtful, people-centered solutions. You’re someone who makes things happen while building trust and collaboration across teams.

What you will do

  1. Partner with business leaders and employees across Brazil to provide day-to-day support on key HR processes — from onboarding and employee relations to development and engagement.
  2. Deliver a best-in-class onboarding experience.
  3. Implement surveys, analyze data, and develop action plans to close gaps.
  4. Manage Rewards and Incentives: leverage current compensation and incentive plans, as well as benchmarking against other companies and industries to ensure our schemes are fit for the future.
  5. Prepare reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing data and trends.
  6. Protect the organization’s value by keeping information confidential.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior Backend Engineer

Location: Remote (LATAM)

Type: Full-time

Reports to: CTO

About Foldspace AI

Foldspace AI is reimagining how users interact with software. We embed a real-time AI agent directly into SaaS applications—not just to chat, but to act. Our agent understands user behavior, triggers features, and renders UI components dynamically—turning complex interfaces into smart, intuitive, outcome-driven experiences. We are a seed-stage startup backed by leading investors, building a team of world-class engineers to create the core of our product and solve some of the most challenging problems in applied AI.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help architect and scale the systems behind our AI-powered agent. You’ll build performant APIs, orchestrate LLM workflows, manage contextual memory, and ensure low-latency performance across high-scale, multi-tenant environments.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role. You’ll work closely with our CTO, AI team, and product leads to develop foundational infrastructure for a truly agentic user experience.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and implement scalable, low-latency backend services using Java
  • Build and maintain APIs that support real-time agent actions and feature execution
  • Orchestrate LLM workflows including prompt routing, context injection, and memory management
  • Develop secure, multi-tenant APIs for our web application.
  • Leverage BigQuery, Mongo, Redis, Dataflow, and Pub/Sub for real-time analytics, caching, and messaging
  • Ensure observability, traceability, and reliability across agent behaviors and backend systems
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with AI, product, and frontend teams to deliver seamless, intelligent user flows

Tech Stack

  • Language: Java
  • Cloud: Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Data & Messaging: BigQuery, MySQL, Mongo, Redis, Pub/Sub
  • AI/LLM: OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, LLM orchestration framework, vector DBs
  • Infra & Tooling: Docker, Terraform, CI/CD, GCP Cloud Monitoring

What You Bring

  • A deep sense of ownership and accountability, the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, autonomous environment, and the drive to produce high-quality features end-to-end.
  • 5+ years of backend engineering experience, preferably in high-scale, real-time systems
  • Deep expertise in Java and backend architecture
  • Strong expertise in multi-tenant architecture, system scalability, and security best practices.
  • Passion for performance, reliability, and building robust systems

Bonus If You Have

  • Experience with agentic systems or LLM-driven user interfaces
  • Familiarity with LLM integrations and AI workflow orchestration in production environments
  • Built systems for context-aware personalization or dynamic workflow execution
  • Experience with GCP, BigQuery, Redis, Pub/Sub, Mongo, and event-driven systems
  • Familiarity with conversational memory, embeddings, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)

Why Join Foldspace?

We’re building one of the first real-time, agentic systems designed to fundamentally change the way people use software. This isn’t just adding AI to a product—it’s rethinking the interface itself. You’ll help build the backend that powers intelligent, contextual, action-oriented experiences. Our core advantage is our team; we are a small, focused group of senior and staff engineers, and our ability to solve complex problems with exceptional speed is our superpower. If you want to work on bleeding-edge systems with deep technical challenges and massive user impact, you’ll thrive here.

title: Desenvolvedor FullStack Especialista - Java/Angular
description:

Missão do Cargo

Desenvolver e manter soluções de software robustas, escaláveis e seguras, aplicando as melhores práticas de engenharia, garantindo qualidade, estabilidade e evolução contínua das aplicações. Qualidade, Segurança e Sustentação

Implementar testes automatizados (JUnit, Mockito, TDD/BDD) e monitorar qualidade com SonarQube.

Aplicar práticas de segurança, incluindo análise de vulnerabilidades e proteção de APIs e dados sensíveis.

Realizar sustentação, correção de bugs e monitoramento de aplicações em produção.

Infraestrutura e DevOps

Trabalhar em ambientes Linux, configurando e otimizando ambientes de desenvolvimento e produção.

Utilizar serviços AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, S3, ECS/EKS, CloudWatch) para deploy, escalabilidade e observabilidade.

Requisitos Técnicos (Hard Skills)

Java 8+ (streams, lambdas, API de datas).

Angular 8+

Spring Boot (MVC, Data, Security).

APIs RESTful com boas práticas.

Bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL, desejável DB2).

Git/GitHub, GitHub Actions, Maven, SonarQube, Nexus.

Testes automatizados (JUnit, Mockito).

Experiência com microserviços, arquitetura distribuída e cloud (AWS).

Conhecimentos em segurança (criptografia, certificados digitais).

Desejável: arquitetura orientada a eventos, ferramentas de transferência de arquivos (Connect Direct, XFB, CFT).

Protagonismo e senso de dono nas entregas.

Colaboração e boa comunicação em squads multifuncionais.

Pensamento crítico, capacidade de propor melhorias e resolver problemas.

Adaptabilidade a mudanças e aprendizado contínuo.

Autonomia com responsabilidade e disposição para pedir ajuda quando necessário.

Ensino Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas.

Mínimo de 10 anos em desenvolvimento de software, preferencialmente em ambientes de missão crítica.

  • Manage and supervise a diverse team of florists, assistants, retail managers, drivers, cleaners, and event setup experts.
  • Coordinate with clients to understand their floral needs and preferences.
  • Ensure the timely delivery and setup of floral arrangements for events and venues.
  • Oversee retail operations, including inventory management, customer service, and sales.
  • Contribute to the overall creative direction and vision of Flowers by EA.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience as a Senior Florist or Experienced Florist in a busy and successful floral business.

title: Analista de compras
description:
ANALISTA DE COMPRAS JR. – Desenvolva, Contribua, Cresça

Empresa jovem, com alma de startup e crescimento sólido no mundo dos insumos estratégicos para os segmentos de agronegócio e life science , busca um(a) Analista de Compras Jr. para integrar sua equipe.

Procuramos gente curiosa, com paixão por fazer acontecer, senso de urgência e prazer em negociar .

Gente que gosta de pessoas, valoriza parcerias duradouras e quer crescer junto , construindo relacionamentos sólidos e de confiança.

Neste papel, as compras não são apenas rotina — são parte central das decisões que impulsionam o crescimento do negócio.

Você atuará com compras diretas e indiretas , terá contato com processos de importação , será responsável por orçamentos, contratos, amostras e apoiará o relacionamento com fornecedores internacionais , com visibilidade e espaço real para crescer .

O que você vai fazer
  • Gerir orçamentos e efetivar compras de todo o leque indireto da empresa, apoiando a operação e o negócio.
  • Conduzir cotações, negociar, comparar ofertas e fechar contratos.
  • Cuidar do processo de amostras internacionais , da solicitação até a entrega em estoque.
  • Manter fornecedores, documentos, cadastros e indicadores em ordem — usando seu conhecimento em Excel avançado e inglês fluente .
  • Colaborar em melhorias de processo na área de Compras, sempre com mentalidade de crescimento.
Quem estamos procurando
  • Profissional com inglês avançado ou fluente (obrigatório). Conhecimento em mandarim é diferencial.
  • Excel avançado é mandatório.
  • Formação superior completa ou em curso em Administração, Comércio Exterior, Economia ou áreas correlatas .
  • Perfil organizado, comunicativo, proativo e dinâmico , com agilidade para lidar com diferentes demandas e fome de aprender e crescer – não só de “cumprir tarefas”.
  • Priorizamos candidatos da região de Barueri/SP e arredores .
Por que vale a pena

Você terá visibilidade estratégica , contato com processos internacionais, aprendizado contínuo e oportunidades reais de crescimento — em um ambiente que valoriza pessoas que entregam, aprendem e fazem acontecer .

Se identificou?

Se você busca mais do que um emprego — e quer a chance de se desenvolver, aprender com propósito e crescer junto com o negócio — esse é o seu momento.

Descrição mais detalhada da vaga:

ANALISTA DE COMPRAS

Oportunidade para iniciar  na área de Compras, com  alta exposição a temas  estratégicos e possibilidades reais de  aprendizado e  crescimento .

Ideal para profissionais que desejam desenvolver  carreira sólida em Compras e Produtos, ampliando sua  visão de negócio e contribuindo ativamente para a  eficiência e  competitividade da empresa.

Função Principal

Dar suporte direto à área de Compras e Produtos, atuando em  compras diretas e indiretas — nacionais e internacionais , incluindo  processos logísticos  (BIDs de fretes e armazéns, quando houver necessidade), garantindo eficiência, qualidade e padronização dos processos.

A posição integra o núcleo estratégico da empresa e oferece  amplo aprendizado e exposição , com envolvimento em negociações, contratos, importação, gestão de fornecedores e relacionamento com diversas áreas internas.

Atividades Principais

  • Conduzir as etapas operacionais de  compras indiretas de toda a empresa, desde o levantamento de necessidades até a emissão de pedidos.
  • Coordenar cotações e processos de compra de serviços e materiais indiretos, assegurando qualidade, prazos e melhor relação custo-benefício.
  • Realizar cotações, negociações e comparativos comerciais , assegurando atualização e precisão das informações.
  • Emitir pedidos de compras indiretas e conduzir o fechamento de contratos junto aos fornecedores, quando aplicável.
  • Efetivar as compras indiretas de todas as áreas da empresa, centralizando orçamentos e processos de aquisição de materiais e serviços administrativos (marketing,  facilities , eventos, escritório, brindes, entre outros).
  • Gerenciar contratos, cadastros e documentos de fornecedores das compras realizadas, garantindo rastreabilidade e conformidade com as políticas internas. Atenção: o gerenciamento do contrato refere-se apenas às etapas de contratação e vencimento. A administração do contrato e o acompanhamento da execução dos serviços permanecem sob responsabilidade da área solicitante.
  • Atualizar o ERP com todos os dados e previsões de chegada de pedidos de compras nacionais e importados.
  • Acompanhar o processo de solicitação e controle de amostras de produtos , desde o pedido até a chegada em estoque, garantindo que prazos e condições sejam cumpridos.
  • Apoiar a análise de dados e indicadores da área de Compras , utilizando Excel avançado para apoiar decisões e otimizar processos.
  • Preparar relatórios e bases de dados de apoio às análises de compras, precificação, S&OP e movimentação de produtos.
  • Construir base de dados para análise de mercado dos itens produtivos , considerando a curva ABC da empresa.
  • Gerir processos courier  e apoiar a gestão da documentação de importação , exercendo interface com o time financeiro quanto ao cronograma de pagamentos.
  • Contribuir para a organização e padronização dos processos de importação e compras internacionais , em alinhamento com os procedimentos internos.
  • Apoiar a execução de projetos de melhoria contínua , propondo soluções práticas para ganho de produtividade.
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa, proativa, analítica e dinâmica , demonstrando curiosidade e interesse genuíno em compreender o negócio e ampliar sua visão estratégica.

Requisitos

  • Formação: Ensino superior completo ou cursando (Administração, Comércio Exterior, Economia ou áreas correlatas).
  • Idiomas: Inglês fluente ou avançado ( obrigatório ). Conhecimento em  Mandarim será considerado um diferencial.
  • Competências digitais: Excel avançado ( obrigatório ) e experiência com ERP ( desejável , preferencialmente SAP).
  • Perfil comportamental:  Organização,  senso de prioridade , comunicação assertiva, capacidade analítica, espírito de equipe, proatividade e  dinamismo  - com  agilidade para lidar com diferentes demandas e disposição genuína para aprender e crescer.
  • Diferencial: Experiência prévia em rotinas de compras (diretas, indiretas ou internacionais).

Reporta-se à  Gerência de Compras e Produtos .

description:

Location: Remote in Brazil

About the Role

We are seeking an Associate Principal – Architecture with strong technical leadership and deep expertise in Azure PaaS application modernization . This role focuses on designing target-state cloud architectures, leading modernization and migration efforts, and guiding engineering teams to deliver scalable, secure, and high-performing enterprise applications.

The ideal candidate brings a balance of hands-on technical depth , architectural strategy, and the ability to lead and mentor technical teams .

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and execute modernization and migration initiatives to Azure PaaS services (e.g., App Service, Azure Functions, AKS, Container Instances).

  • Provide technical leadership to teams of 5+ engineers, ensuring architectural alignment and delivery excellence.
  • Design and implement Azure Landing Zones following best practices for security, governance, and networking.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Data, DevOps, and Integration teams to ensure end-to-end solution coherence.

Technical Requirements

  • 13+ years of experience in application development and modernization.
  • Strong hands-on experience migrating and hosting applications on Azure PaaS (App Services, Functions, AKS).
  • Experience with IIS hosting , containerization, and Kubernetes-based runtime environments.
  • Solid understanding of application architecture, integrations, networking, and security patterns .
  • Working knowledge of database connectivity, caching, session management, and configuration best practices .
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot and optimize Azure application environments .

Leadership Expectations

  • Experience leading teams of 5+ engineers , with the ability to mentor, coach, and guide.
  • Capable of aligning technical direction to business priorities and delivering to timelines.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including executive-level engagement.

Soft Skills

  • Clear, concise communication in English (written and spoken).
  • Strong client-facing and presentation skills.
  • Collaborative mindset and positive attitude.
  • Strong analytical and decision-making ability.

Administrar a regulação de sinistro, seguindo todas as etapas do processo (documentação, elaboração de relatórios, realização de pericias, avaliação de apólice), diagnosticando os prejuízos envolvidos e o ressarcimento com base na apólice do segurado.

5. Monitorar status dos sinistros de acordo com a parametrização estabelecida pela empresa e controlada pela Administração da Regulação.

6. Solicitar aprovação de faturamento parcial, intermediário ou final, enviando para a seguradora a prévia do time sheet com resumo das despesas e honorários e disparando e-mail para o financeiro faturar mediante aprovação da seguradora.

Mínimo de 1 ano de experiência na regulação de sinistros.

Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia .

title: Especialista Fiscal (ERP)
description:
Nós da Odoo acreditamos que softwares para gerenciar negócios devem cobrir necessidades complexas sem serem complicados. Somos um conjunto de aplicativos de negócios em código aberto que cobre todas as necessidades das pequenas e médias empresas: CRM, e-commerce, contabilidade, estoque… Ajudamos empresas a se tornarem mais eficientes, gastando menos!

Aqui na Odoo, Especialistas Fiscais são pessoas colaborativas, orientadas para resultados, com visão analítica e paixão por tecnologia. São responsáveis por garantir o sucesso da Localização Brasileira no nosso software, implementando seus módulos e atuando em contato direto com os clientes para assegurar a conformidade com as legislações fiscais e tributárias.

Para isso, você será a linha de frente, analisando as necessidades dos clientes, projetando a solução, configurando os fluxos fiscais, e fornecendo sessões de treinamento . Sua atuação é crucial para garantir que os projetos sejam entregues dentro do prazo e do orçamento, além de ser um ponto importante de apoio para o time de P.O. de Localização Brasileira.

Também será responsável por manter atualizada a nossa base de conhecimento dos fluxos de localização brasileira, facilitando a autonomia do cliente após a implementação.

Basicamente, você será responsável por fornecer a melhor solução de gerenciamento fiscal/contábil aos seus clientes, prestando suporte interno com as demandas fiscais e tributárias necessárias para facilitar os negócios dos nossos clientes, apoiando PMEs de diversos setores a extrair o máximo valor da Odoo. Atuamos com foco no usuário, de maneira ágil, dinâmica e sempre pensando no longo prazo.

Responsabilidades e dia a dia:

  • Gerenciar o relacionamento com os clientes durante a implementação do Odoo.
  • Analisar as necessidades do cliente e os requisitos fiscais e contábeis.
  • Prestar apoio para time interno de Analistas de Negócios e Time Comercial com dúvidas e validações contábeis/fiscais.
  • Garantir que os projetos estão em conformidade com as fundamentações fiscais corretas através da operacionalização no Portal Avalara (será treinado).
  • Atuará com implementação de projetos compreendendo a nova reforma tributária a partir de 2026.
  • Documentar os cenários de validação fiscal dos projetos, gerar relatórios e documentações dos fluxos fiscais para documentação interna e documentação de cliente.
  • Atuar diretamente em contato com o P.O. do produto de Localização Brasileira para apoiar em especificações técnicas e testes de funcionalidades e bugfixes.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Inglês avançado para leitura, escrita e eventual conversação;
  • Excelente organização, com capacidade de atuar em várias frentes simultâneas em um ambiente dinâmico;
  • Conhecimento avançado de Excel para trabalhar com tabelas dinâmicas, gráficos dinâmicos, macros (VBA) e automatizações ;

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: HR Operation Senior Specialist
description:
【Responsibilities】

title: Data Modeler
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.

Job Purpose:

The Data Modeler will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining robust data models and SQL-based solutions, with a focus on Google Cloud Platform. This role will ensure data integrity, optimize database performance, and support data-driven initiatives, particularly within the higher education sector.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Data Modelling and SQL Development

  • Design and implement scalable and efficient relational and dimensional data models.
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and functions.
  • Ensure data quality and integrity across various data sources and reporting layers.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into technical specifications.

Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Expertise

  • Utilize GCP services such as BigQuery, Cloud SQL, and Dataflow for data storage, processing, and analysis.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based data warehouses and data lakes on GCP.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code solutions for GCP data environments using tools like Terraform.
  • Monitor and optimize GCP resource performance and cost for data platforms.

Collaboration and Communication

  • Serve as a primary liaison among business leads, product managers, and data/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation for data solutions.
  • Promote adoption of new data capabilities and practices; gather feedback for continuous improvement.

Release and Change Management

  • Coordinate release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for data model and SQL deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered for data solutions.
  • Track post-release issues, adoption, and stabilization metrics related to data platforms.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.
  • “Can-do” attitude with unwavering ethics and a willingness to help others.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.
  • Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.

Requirements:

  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with relational database design and data modelling.
  • Demonstrable experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) data services (e.g., BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Dataflow).
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code solutions, e.g., Terraform.
  • Experience with data quality checks and data governance best practices.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers, e.g., GitHub/BitBucket/GitLab.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience in the higher education space.
  • Experience with data orchestration frameworks, e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, dbt.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools for data platforms.
  • Familiarity with Python for data scripting and automation.

Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent life/work experience.
  • 5+ years in SQL engineering, data modelling, data engineering, or a related data-centric role, preferably within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.

We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Finance Analyst
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Financial Operations Analyst to join our growing finance team. This role is essential to ensuring the accuracy, compliance, and efficiency of our financial operations in Brazil, from end-to-end payment execution and accounting control to tax compliance and audit-ready documentation.

The ideal candidate has a solid background in end-to-end payment processing, a strong understanding of the banking environment, experience with domestic and international transactions (FX payments), and the accounting knowledge required to accurately book and reconcile all financial movements. Additionally, this person will have a solid grasp of withholding tax requirements, the ability to issue service invoices (NFS-e), and a strong focus on internal controls and documentation processes. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work in a dynamic, international environment and collaborate closely with teams in Brazil, Singapore, and Japan.

Key Responsibilities

Accounts Payable and Payment Operations

  • Manage the full accounts payable cycle, including receiving, reviewing, and verifying invoices for accuracy and compliance with company policies.
  • Execute and monitor domestic and foreign currency (FX) payments, including supplier invoices, intercompany transactions, and service fees.
  • Operate banking platforms with accuracy and control, ensuring timely payment execution and proper approval workflows.
  • Track and manage payment terms, proactively resolving discrepancies and maintaining strong supplier relationships.
  • Coordinate with BPO providers and internal stakeholders to resolve payment-related issues and provide regular payment status updates.
  • Review, validate, and process employee reimbursement claims, ensuring policy compliance, complete documentation, and readiness for audits.
  • Support the continuous improvement of payment procedures and contribute to the development of updated policies and standard operating procedures to enhance efficiency and compliance.

Tax and Invoicing

  • Identify, calculate, and control withholding taxes such as IRRF, ISS, PIS/COFINS, and INSS on supplier invoices and service payments.
  • Ensure proper tax treatment and accurate accounting of all transactions, including cross-border payments.
  • Prepare and issue service invoices (NFS-e) for intercompany and third-party transactions in compliance with municipal regulations and internal policies.
  • Support tax reconciliations, documentation, and reporting required for audits and statutory filings.

Accounting, Reporting, and Internal Controls

  • Accurately record, classify, and reconcile all payment transactions in the general ledger, ensuring proper accounting treatment.
  • Support the maintenance of the chart of accounts, including the creation and updating of GL accounts and cost centers.
  • Assist with monthly closing activities and prepare financial reporting packages for submission to the headquarters in Singapore.
  • Support internal and external audit requests by preparing and organizing documentation that meets governance and compliance requirements.
  • Contribute to building and strengthening internal controls, documentation standards, and compliance processes across all payment, accounting, and tax operations.

Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Native or bilingual proficiency in Portuguese and professional working proficiency in English (CEFR B2 or above).
  • 2 to 3 years of experience in accounts payable, payment processing, treasury operations, accounting, or similar finance roles, preferably in a multinational environment.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian payment processes, tax obligations, and withholding tax requirements.
  • Proven experience issuing service invoices (NFS-e) and ensuring compliance with fiscal requirements.
  • Hands-on experience with FX payments, international transactions, and corporate banking platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Solid knowledge of internal controls, documentation standards, and audit requirements.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional and international teams.

Why Join Us

  • You will be part of a dynamic finance team that plays a strategic role in our company’s expansion and operations in Brazil. This is a unique opportunity to deepen your expertise in payments, accounting, tax compliance, and internal controls while contributing to the growth of a global organization with strong connections to Singapore and Japan.

title: Registration Assistant
description:
Mission of the Role:

Due to growth & expansion of business in Brazil, CAC is looking to hire a seasoned professional who will be responsible for support and accelerate product registration and compliance activities in the Brazilian market , reporting to Registration manager in Brazil. The key objectives for this role are:

  • Managing the submission, follow-up, and maintenance of product registrations in Brazil
  • ensures compliance with national regulatory requirements (MAPA, IBAMA, ANVISA) and supports the company’s product launch plans in alignment with global and regional regulatory strategies.

Key Accountabilities:

  • Develop and execute registration strategies for Brazil in line with business priorities and product portfolio
  • Prepare, compile, and submit registration dossiers for technical and formulated products in compliance with local regulatory requirements
  • Coordinate with external consultants, laboratories, manufacturers, and internal technical teams to ensure high-quality and complete submissions.
  • Communicate with regulatory authorities (MAPA, IBAMA, ANVISA) through local partners or directly when required.
  • Monitor progress of submissions, follow up on authority requests, and manage timelines to ensure efficient approval.
  • Track and analyze updates in Brazilian and LATAM regulatory frameworks, assessing potential business impacts and advising management accordingly.
  • Maintain accurate registration data and documentation archives to ensure full traceability and compliance.
  • Provide regulatory support to commercial, marketing, and R&D teams regarding registration timelines, status, and compliance requirements.
  • Support post-registration activities, such as renewals, label updates, and re-registration processes.
  • Collaborate with global regulatory teams to align strategies and share best practices.

Technical Knowledge and Skills:

  • Graduate in Agricultural Science, Chemistry, Toxicology, Environmental Science, or related fields.
  • 4 years of working experience in regulatory affairs or product registration within the agrochemical / crop protection industry.
  • In-depth understanding of Brazil’s registration procedures and authorities: MAPA/IBMA/ANVISA and state authorities.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple registration projects with strict timelines
  • Strong coordination and communication skills with internal cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in English (written & spoken) and Portuguese (mandatory for Brazil-based communication).
  • Detail-oriented and capable of interpreting technical and scientific data.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Previous experience in a multinational agrochemical company or regulatory consulting firm

Soft skill:

  • Demonstrates a proactive, self-driven approach with a high sense of accountability.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, cross-cultural environment

title: On-Site IT Support Engineer
description:
Overview

We are looking for a dedicated and proactive On-Site IT Support Engineer to provide hands-on support for our local infrastructure, users, and critical systems. This role ensures smooth IT operations, continuity of services, and timely resolution of incidents during the designated support period. The engineer will serve as the primary point of contact for IT-related issues at the site, while also performing preventive maintenance and ensuring system stability.

Key Responsibilities

Scope of Work / Activities to be Covered

  • Provide on-site support for resolving technical incidents related to infrastructure, systems, and end-user devices.
  • Perform monitoring of IT equipment and infrastructure maintenance , ensuring uptime and reliability.
  • Offer desktop/user support for local staff, including troubleshooting hardware, software, and connectivity issues.
  • Conduct preventive maintenance activities such as security checks, system health checks, and patch updates.
  • Monitor and coordinate critical service requests with remote teams and vendors as needed.
  • Assist in escalating complex incidents to higher-level support teams while ensuring proper follow-through.

Expected Results

  • Operational Continuity Maintenance: Ensure that business processes and local operations remain unaffected during the support period.
  • Quality of Service: Deliver efficient, timely, and professional IT support with effective problem-solving skills.
  • Reliable Technical Support: Minimize downtime and interruptions across IT systems and infrastructure.
  • Documentation and Reporting: Prepare and submit clear incident logs, resolution details, and preventive maintenance reports for transparency and accountability.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Proven experience in IT support, helpdesk, or desktop engineering roles .
  • Strong knowledge of Windows/Mac operating systems, networking basics, hardware, and peripherals .
  • Familiarity with ITSM ticketing systems and incident management processes.
  • Ability to conduct preventive maintenance and security checks .
  • Strong communication skills and ability to interact with end-users at all levels.
  • Detail-oriented with strong documentation and reporting skills.
  • Professional certifications (CompTIA A+, Network+, ITIL, or Microsoft/CCNA) are a plus.

title: Analista Sr. Planejamento de Produto
description:
Na Hyundai Motor Brasil, buscamos profissionais comprometidos e apaixonados pela excelência.

Como Analista Sr. de Planejamento de Produto, você será responsável por planejar um line up de produtos competitivo e com alta rentabilidade, assegurando as metas projetadas de volume e market share no mercado brasileiro.

As principais atividades são:

  • Propor e definir o Sales Plan para futuros produtos (specs, volume, preço, mix, competitividade), considerando as tendências do mercado e visando sempre alcançar as metas corporativas de market share e rentabilidade;
  • Interagir ativamente com a matriz, fornecendo diretrizes aprofundadas acerca das tendências do mercado e necessidades dos consumidores que guiarão o desenvolvimento de novos produtos;
  • Gerenciar ativamente todos os aspectos do planejamento do produto sob responsabilidade ao longo do processo de desenvolvimento de novo produto, interagindo com as diversas áreas relacionadas para garantir que o novo produto esteja adequado ao mercado brasileiro sob todos os aspectos;
  • Análise de P&L por produto/versão/mercado, de forma a monitorar o profitability do grupo de produtos sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Monitoramento das ações dos competidores, analisando seus impactos e identificando oportunidades de ações ou contramedidas que mantenham ou aumentem a competitividade do produto e a força da marca;
  • Liderar as análises para introdução de novas tecnologias para a região;
  • Elaboração de análises do produto versus a concorrência abrangendo competitividade, posicionamento, análise de valor, amplitude de preço e cobertura no segmento;
  • Análise e efetiva utilização de Pesquisas de Mercado para aprimoramento do produto;
  • Participação em fóruns multifuncionais para definição de alterações em produtos;
  • Preparação e apresentação de reports para a gerência e diretoria.

Se interessou? Os requisitos para concorrer à vaga são:

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência na área de planejamento de produto na indústria automobilística;
  • Excel e PowerPoint avançados;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Power BI será um diferencial;
  • Experiência em planejamento de Powertrain será um diferencial;
  • Experiência em gerenciamento de projetos será um diferencial.

A Hyundai Motor Company, sediada na Coreia do Sul, está passando por uma transição significativa de ser fabricante de automóveis para se tornar provedora de soluções de mobilidade inteligente. Movimento audacioso, energia positiva e trabalho de qualidade; este é o nosso DNA Hyundai; este foi o poder que nos permitiu ser líder global na indústria automotiva e será o poder para criar um novo mundo.   • Entrega & Pós-obra: coordenar comissionamento, manual do proprietário, Vistoria de Entrega , pendências e transição para Assistência Técnica .

Indicadores (KPIs)

  • Aderência ao cronograma (variação % físico).
  • Custo x Orçado (desvio %) e giro de estoque .
  • Índice de retrabalho e não conformidades por etapa.
  • Taxa de incidentes/horas trabalhadas .
  • Produtividade por frente/empreiteiro.
  • Cumprimento do PPC e lead time de restrições.

Requisitos

  • Graduação em Engenharia Civil (concluída) e CREA ativo .
  • Experiência prévia como Engenheiro de Obra/Residente em edificações verticais e/ou paredes de concreto.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência com Lean Construction/Last Planner (PPC) , BIM/compatibilização, paredes de concreto e sistemas industrializados.
  • Experiência com ERP/Sienge (ou similar), gestão de contratos e curvas S físico-financeiras.
  • Histórico de entrega com baixo desvio de custo e aderência de prazo .

Perfil Comportamental

  • Senso de dono e execução: decide, prioriza e entrega.
  • Organização e disciplina: ritos, padrões e registros impecáveis.
  • Comunicação e liderança: alinha frentes, dá feedback claro e desenvolve o time.
  • Análise crítica e dados: usa indicadores para ajustar rota.
  • Resiliência e segurança: mantém padrão sob pressão.

Remuneração e Benefícios

  • Remuneração fixa compatível com o mercado e senioridade.
  • Ganhos variáveis vinculados a metas de obra (prazo/custo/qualidade/SST).
  • Benefícios: vale-refeição/alimentação, plano de saúde e auxílio combustível.

Aplicação: somente candidatos já residentes em Porto Alegre ou Região Metropolitana.

title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
Job Responsibilities:

1. Provide professional HR advice to business management, supporting organizational development, talent retention, and performance improvement;

2. Lead employee relations management, effectively handling employee conflicts, disciplinary issues, and high-risk resignation cases;

3. Responsible for the full process management of employee departures, including termination negotiations, completion of exit formalities, calculation of compensation (such as FGTS, 13th salary, unused vacation leave conversion, etc.), ensuring full compliance and minimizing legal risks;

4. Manage the implementation of company attendance policies, oversee the operation of the clock-in system, review records of overtime, compensatory leave, and absences, and collaborate with the payroll team to ensure data accuracy;

5. Participate in recruitment demand analysis, performance evaluation promotion, training needs identification, and local compensation and benefits support;

Maintain the Human Resources Information System (HRIS), generate regular human resources data reports, and support decision-making analysis;

6. Assist in promoting corporate culture development, employee engagement initiatives, and organizational change management;

7. Communicate daily with the HR team at headquarters in English, including meeting reports and project collaboration.

Job requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Human Resources, Management, Psychology, Law, or related fields;

2-5 years of relevant experience in human resources, with preference given to candidates who have worked in foreign enterprises, multinational corporations, or large local companies;

3. Proficient in the six major modules of human resources, with solid general HR knowledge and practical experience;

4. Possess extensive experience in offboarding management, familiar with the relevant provisions of Brazil's Consolidated Labor Laws (CLT), and capable of independently handling complex termination processes;

5. Possess practical experience in attendance and timekeeping management, with familiarity in working hour systems, overtime approval processes, and flexible work arrangements;

Fluent in English listening, speaking, reading, and writing, capable of conducting meetings, handling email correspondence, and drafting reports in English (it is recommended to include a fully English assessment session during the interview);

6. Proficient in using Office productivity software , with priority given to those familiar with mainstream HR systems;

7. Possess strong communication and coordination skills, problem-solving abilities, and cross-cultural sensitivity.

title: Data Security Engineer - Microsoft Purview
description:
Join our team as a ¡MS Purview Data Security Engineer – Email Security !. We’re searching for someone who has fresh ideas and a unique viewpoint, and who enjoys collaborating with a cross-functional team to develop real-world solutions and positive user experiences for every interaction.

title: Cloud Engineer with Data Platforms Experience
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.

Job Purpose:

The Cloud Engineer with Data Platforms Experience will be responsible for building and maintaining cloud infrastructure and applications that primarily interface with data platforms, as well as building and maintaining Python-based applications that may or may not be deployed in the cloud. This role will ensure that our cloud environments and data-centric applications are built, configured, optimized, and adopted to meet evolving needs. The Cloud Engineer will own infrastructure requirements, configuration standards, performance optimization, and cross-team coordination related to cloud and data platforms.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Cloud Infrastructure and Data Platforms

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable and secure cloud infrastructure that supports data platforms.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based data platforms such as BigQuery/Redshift, GCS/S3, etc.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code solutions using tools like Terraform/CloudFormation.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based CI/CD workflows for infrastructure and data platform deployments.
  • Monitor and optimize cloud resource performance and cost.
  • Ensure data quality checks for source, integration, and reporting layers; escalate defects with clear reproduction steps and impact.

Python Application Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain Python-based applications, both cloud-deployed and on-premises.
  • Utilize Python libraries such as Flask for application development.
  • Implement and manage CI/CD workflows for Python applications.
  • Collaborate with development teams to integrate applications with cloud and data platforms.

Collaboration and Communication

  • Serve as a primary liaison among business leads, product managers, and data/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation for data solutions.
  • Promote adoption of new data capabilities and practices; gather feedback for continuous improvement.

Release and Change Management

  • Coordinate release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for data model and SQL deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered for data solutions.
  • Track post-release issues, adoption, and stabilization metrics related to data platforms.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.
  • “Can-do” attitude with unwavering ethics and a willingness to help others.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.
  • Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.

Requirements:

  • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms, e.g., BigQuery/Redshift, GCS/S3, and etc.
  • Infrastructure-as-code solutions, e.g., Terraform/CloudFormation.
  • Cloud-based CI/CD workflows.
  • Performance and cost optimization for cloud resources.
  • Experience with Python and familiarity with libraries such as Flask.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers, e.g., GitHub/BitBucket/GitLab.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Cloud-based IAM, networking, and security.
  • Experience with data orchestration frameworks, e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, dbt.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools.

Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent life/work experience.
  • 5+ years in cloud engineering, data engineering, systems administration, or product operations within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.

We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Company Description

RockSpoon is seeking an experienced Senior Product Designer to join our team on-site in São Paulo. In this leadership role, you will craft and oversee user experiences that are exceptionally intuitive, requiring no training or tooltips for users. You will champion a design philosophy that emphasizes clarity, minimalism, and intuitive design thinking to achieve outstanding usability across our product line. Working across our cross-platform suite (iOS, Android, Windows, macOS), you will leverage effective visual hierarchy, layout, and interaction cues to guide users effortlessly. This full-time position involves collaborating closely with product managers, engineers, and other designers; you will also mentor team members and shape our design system to deliver an exceptional user experience.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead intuitive UX design: Lead the design of clear, self-explanatory user interfaces and workflows. Leverage visual hierarchy, layout, and intuitive interaction cues to guide users, ensuring the product is so intuitive that no training or tooltips are needed.
  • Product design strategy: Drive the UX/UI design strategy with a strong focus on usability, minimalism, and intuitive design principles. Align design objectives with product goals to deliver a simple, elegant, and highly usable experience for users.
  • Cross-platform oversight: Oversee and contribute to the design of features across mobile and desktop platforms (iOS, Android, Windows, macOS). Ensure a consistent, seamless user experience that respects platform-specific guidelines while maintaining a unified product identity.
  • Design and prototyping: Create detailed wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, and interactive prototypes in Figma to communicate design concepts. Iterate quickly based on feedback and usability findings to refine the user experience.
  • Design system ownership: Own and evolve RockSpoon’s design system and style guides. Establish UI standards and reusable components that promote a cohesive, intuitive, and minimalist interface across all products.
  • Collaboration with stakeholders: Work closely with product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders from concept through launch. Ensure feasibility of designs and a smooth handoff to development, while advocating for the best user experience.
  • Mentorship and leadership: Mentor and provide guidance to mid-level and junior designers. Foster a culture of user-centered, intuitive design thinking within the team through knowledge sharing, code/design reviews, and continuous feedback.
  • User research & testing: Champion user research and usability testing efforts. Plan or participate in user interviews, UI tests, and analytics reviews to validate design decisions, using insights to continuously improve the product’s clarity and ease of use.
  • Usability and accessibility standards: Ensure all designs meet high standards for usability and accessibility. Deliver a frictionless, responsive experience for a diverse user base, and refine interactions to eliminate pain points and confusion.
Qualifications & Skills
  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in product design, UX/UI design, or a similar role, with significant experience leading design projects or initiatives. Proven track record of delivering successful and intuitive digital products or features.
  • Portfolio: An outstanding portfolio showcasing your product design work. Should include examples of complex applications you’ve made simple through intuitive design, demonstrating excellent usability, visual clarity, and minimalistic style.
  • Expert UX/UI knowledge: Deep knowledge of user experience principles and interaction design. Comfortable with information architecture, user flows, and usability heuristics. Ability to simplify complex workflows and create interfaces that feel natural to users.
  • Cross-platform expertise: Extensive experience designing for a range of platforms – native mobile (iOS and Android) and web/desktop applications. Familiarity with the best practices and constraints of each platform, and ability to create cohesive experiences across them.
  • Design tools & systems: Mastery of design and prototyping tools, especially Figma. Strong experience in building or maintaining design systems and component libraries. Able to enforce and evolve a consistent design language at scale.
  • Leadership & collaboration: Excellent leadership and interpersonal skills. Ability to lead design discussions, clearly communicate design rationale, and influence product strategy. Experience collaborating in cross-functional teams and working closely with engineering and product management.
  • Intuitive design mindset: Demonstrated intuitive design thinking and problem-solving ability. Passion for usability and minimalism – you instinctively design solutions that feel easy and obvious to the end user, without extraneous complexity.
  • Communication & language: Strong verbal and written communication skills in English (required for daily use). Portuguese language skills are a plus and will be helpful in the local office environment.
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Design, HCI, Interaction Design, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

title: Software Engineer, Data Integrations
description:
Blawk is building next-generation infrastructure to automate and analyze financial data at scale across the entertainment and creator economy.

We’re looking for a Software Engineer (Data Integrations) to help design and develop reliable automation pipelines for ingesting, mapping, and enriching large datasets from multiple external platforms. You’ll play a key role in connecting Blawk’s backend systems to external data sources, ensuring our data remains accurate, normalized, and scalable.

You’ll collaborate closely with our Founding Engineer to bring new data integrations online, enhance our normalization logic, and improve the reliability of ingestion across multiple environments.

This will start part-time, and advance to Full-time depending on performance. 

What the Candidate Will Do

  • Develop and maintain automation scripts and data ingestion pipelines from external dashboards or portals.
  • Build data mappers that convert multiple schemas into a unified internal data model.
  • Implement error handling, logging, and monitoring for all ingestion jobs.
  • Collaborate with the engineering team to refine the database structure and enrichment logic.
  • Document integration workflows to support scalability and future maintenance.
  • Work independently with clear milestones while communicating progress proactively.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in software engineering or data engineering , preferably in backend or automation-heavy environments.
  • Strong coding skills in JavaScript/TypeScript, mainly inside NestJS and Node.js
  • Strong Experience integrating front end with backend applications such as Next.js 
  • Experience with web automation frameworks (Playwright, Puppeteer, or similar).
  • Solid understanding of SQL-based data modeling and transformation pipelines.
  • Working proficiency in English (does not need to be fluent but able to communicate clearly with the team).
  • Strong ownership mindset and ability to deliver production-quality code with minimal oversight
  • Algorithm & Data Structures fundamentals, including hash tables, trees, stacks, queues, linked list, DFS, BFS.
  • Experience in hands-on software development with thoughtfulness of scale, latency and distributed architecture.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Supabase, PostgreSQL, or other modern cloud databases .
  • Background in ETL pipelines, data normalization, or automation frameworks .
  • Familiarity with browser automation, headless environments, or task scheduling tools & Queue managers. 
  • Passion for building reliable data systems that simplify complex workflows.

Bonus If

  • experience working in media, entertainment, or fintech data systems.
  • Experience with international stakeholders

title: (Contract) Psychotherapist / Psychologist
description:
Part-Time Mental Health Therapist (Hybrid: Remote & In-Person)

Location: Marau, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil

Our mission: to eliminate every barrier to mental health.

Spring Health is the leading comprehensive mental health benefit for employers. We help employees understand their mental health issues and connect with best-in-class providers to get the right treatment at the right time.

From early detection to full recovery, Spring Health is the only clinically validated solution in the market proven to be more effective than traditional mental healthcare. By combining the latest technology with vetted providers, we help engage 1 in 3 employees, reduce recovery times, and lower healthcare costs. We are an award-winning, passionate, and mission-driven team with the support of leaders in psychiatry.

We are seeking qualified, part-time internationally licensed psychotherapists to join our provider network and deliver care with a tech-enabled, AI/machine-learning platform that puts patient outcomes first.

What You'll Do

  • Provide counseling to clients with benefits ranging from short-term goal-focused EAP, to employer health plans allowing as many sessions as medically necessary.
  • Treat adults who have completed brief, evidence-based online screenings identifying their symptoms and areas of concern.
  • Preferably, also be open to treating additional populations such as children, adolescents, couples, or families.
  • Maintain a calendar displaying your availability and complete session documentation in a timely manner within our scheduling system.
  • Use evidence-based treatment modalities and interventions that are tailored to your client’s needs.
  • Collaborate with our dedicated provider support team, our licensed clinical care navigation team, and our administrative care support team whenever you need assistance.
  • Provide culturally competent and empathetic care, upholding our values of diversity and inclusion for all races, ethnicities, and genders.

Who you are

  • You are properly qualified (licensed, if applicable) to practice counseling (as a Psychologist, Psychotherapist, Clinical Psychologist, etc.) in Brazil. We are not able to accept applications from anyone requiring clinical supervision.
  • You maintain active professional liability insurance at market rates in your approved jurisdiction (country of licensure).
  • You have a minimum of 3 years of independent clinical experience.
  • You have access to a computer or laptop, are comfortable with technology, and are tele-health competent.
  • You are available to offer some amount of monthly in-person availability for Spring Health members in Marau.
  • You have training and experience in evidence-based modalities of care such as CBT, DBT, EMDR, ACT, CPT.
  • You are comfortable with providing safety planning and intervention during situations where a client might present with higher risks.
  • You are committed to quality clinical care and want to expand your capabilities and increase your effectiveness by being informed of client progress or challenges.
  • You like working independently, but would also enjoy having the support of a team and opportunities for connections and collaboration with other providers and our master’s level clinical care navigators.

If you are applying to a hybrid role, please be aware that your own office space will be required.

Why you'll like working with Spring Health

  • You’ll set your own schedule to fit your professional and personal needs.
  • Work from anywhere, as long as you have a confidential, private location with stable internet.
  • No need to spend time marketing your practice, checking insurance eligibility, collecting fees, or submitting claims---we take care of the administrative work so that you can focus on clinical care.
  • Grow your ability to provide effective care through feedback from evidence-based measures that help you identify what is working with your clients.
  • Join a dynamic community where you will be supported, your work appreciated, and you’ll have the opportunity to help us shape the future of mental health care!

In addition to finding people who are truly excellent at what they do, we take our values at Spring Health seriously:

Members Come First We are genuine member advocates.

Move Fast to Change Lives We build with urgency and intention.

Take Ownership We extend trust and hold ourselves accountable.

Embrace Diverse Teams & Perspectives We find strength in the diversity of cultural backgrounds, ideas, and experiences.

Science Will Win We will achieve impact by innovation and evidence based frameworks.

Candor with Care We are open, honest and empathetic.

Spring Health is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable legal requirements. Spring Health is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.
