title: Senior Backend Engineering Analyst
description:
Sinch is a global customer engagement platform that provides communication services for businesses across messaging, voice, and email. Sinch's services are used by more than 150,000 businesses, including many of the world's largest tech companies.

Join our development team as a Senior Backend Engineering Analyst ! You will be a key player in developing modern web applications and creating surprising new products for our clients. Our team focuses on building global-scale products and managing numerous direct integrations, including Meta (Facebook) for messaging. We also integrate with various platforms using APIs, queuing, and streaming technologies.


Activities

While responsibilities vary, in a general context, here's what we expect from you daily:

  • Deliver technology projects/products aligned with the company's strategic objectives (OKRs) , collaborating with the product team to suggest and develop new functionalities.
  • Architect and develop APIs for incredible conversational experiences and integrations using modern development technologies.
  • Develop and maintain scalable backend systems for a robust, global messaging platform (e.g., WhatsApp and SMS channels).
  • Collaboratively develop and enhance distributed backend services that meet our customers' needs.
  • Actively participate in discussions about product features and technical solutions to solve customer problems and scale our solution.
  • Master integrations and communications using REST APIs .
  • Practice code versioning (Git) , with experience in Pull Requests and Code Review.
  • Work effectively in a team environment-we don't build software alone!


Requirements

  • Solid experience in a functional language, preferably Elixir.
  • Experience developing RESTful and gRPC APIs .
  • Strong knowledge of distributed system architecture, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns .
  • Practical knowledge of Agile development methodologies .
  • Solid understanding of relational databases .
  • Experience with Unit Testing and Integration Testing .
  • English is a must. You will communicate with teams around the world daily. We expect you to have good English reading skills from the start and be willing to dedicate yourself to learning the language.


We are looking for people who:

  • Enjoy working with talented teammates to raise the technical bar for the team, seeking new solutions and bringing improvements to existing processes.
  • Adapt quickly to change.
  • Have excellent communication skills for interpersonal relationships across different teams and hierarchical levels.

In short, we seek someone willing to deep-dive into the processes, culture, people, and business of Sinch Latam, always prioritizing continuous improvement and contributing to the evolution of our products and services.


Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of other functional languages like Erlang, Go, Rust, or Clojure .
  • Knowledge of other languages like Java and Kotlin .
  • Experience with distributed systems and microservices .
  • Familiarity with container technology (e.g., Docker and Kubernetes ).
  • Experience with messaging systems (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Phoenix PubSub ).
  • Knowledge of NoSQL databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, Elastic Search, etc.).



Benefits

  • Stay healthy: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.
  • Flexible benefits: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance.
  • Family first: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old.
  • Everyday wellbeing: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options.
  • Secure your future : Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities.
  • Diversity and inclusion: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
  • Take a break: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.


Our Hiring Process

In Sinch, we are committed to following a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and non-discriminatory. Our Talent Acquisition team, together with hiring managers and the rest of the interviewing team, persistently work towards identifying the candidates that best fit each open job, based on Sinch' s hiring needs and candidates' career expectations. We encourage applications from strong candidates with relevant professional backgrounds for this role. Not all applicants will meet all job requirements exactly! Even if you do not meet all job requirements, don't let that stop you from considering Sinch for the next step in your career. We are always open to candidates that could bring new ideas and perspectives to Sinch!

title: Senior Backend Engineering Analyst
description:
Sinch is a global customer engagement platform that provides communication services for businesses across messaging, voice, and email. Sinch's services are used by more than 150,000 businesses, including many of the world's largest tech companies.

Join our development team as a Senior Backend Engineering Analyst ! You will be a key player in developing modern web applications and creating surprising new products for our clients. Our team focuses on building global-scale products and managing numerous direct integrations, including Meta (Facebook) for messaging. We also integrate with various platforms using APIs, queuing, and streaming technologies.


Activities

While responsibilities vary, in a general context, here's what we expect from you daily:

  • Deliver technology projects/products aligned with the company's strategic objectives (OKRs) , collaborating with the product team to suggest and develop new functionalities.
  • Architect and develop APIs for incredible conversational experiences and integrations using modern development technologies.
  • Develop and maintain scalable backend systems for a robust, global messaging platform (e.g., WhatsApp and SMS channels).
  • Collaboratively develop and enhance distributed backend services that meet our customers' needs.
  • Actively participate in discussions about product features and technical solutions to solve customer problems and scale our solution.
  • Master integrations and communications using REST APIs .
  • Practice code versioning (Git) , with experience in Pull Requests and Code Review.
  • Work effectively in a team environment-we don't build software alone!


Requirements

  • Solid experience in a functional language, preferably Elixir.
  • Experience developing RESTful and gRPC APIs .
  • Strong knowledge of distributed system architecture, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns .
  • Practical knowledge of Agile development methodologies .
  • Solid understanding of relational databases .
  • Experience with Unit Testing and Integration Testing .
  • English is a must. You will communicate with teams around the world daily. We expect you to have good English reading skills from the start and be willing to dedicate yourself to learning the language.


We are looking for people who:

  • Enjoy working with talented teammates to raise the technical bar for the team, seeking new solutions and bringing improvements to existing processes.
  • Adapt quickly to change.
  • Have excellent communication skills for interpersonal relationships across different teams and hierarchical levels.

In short, we seek someone willing to deep-dive into the processes, culture, people, and business of Sinch Latam, always prioritizing continuous improvement and contributing to the evolution of our products and services.


Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of other functional languages like Erlang, Go, Rust, or Clojure .
  • Knowledge of other languages like Java and Kotlin .
  • Experience with distributed systems and microservices .
  • Familiarity with container technology (e.g., Docker and Kubernetes ).
  • Experience with messaging systems (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Phoenix PubSub ).
  • Knowledge of NoSQL databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, Elastic Search, etc.).



Benefits

  • Stay healthy: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.
  • Flexible benefits: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance.
  • Family first: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old.
  • Everyday wellbeing: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options.
  • Secure your future : Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities.
  • Diversity and inclusion: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
  • Take a break: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.

Even if you do not meet all job requirements, don't let that stop you from considering Sinch for the next step in your career. We are always open to candidates that could bring new ideas and perspectives to Sinch!

description:

title: Senior HRBP LATAM
description:
We're conducting a search for a Strategic Regional Talent Partner with 10+ years of progressive HR experience, an essential and proven focus on the Latin American (LATAM) region, and fluency in Portuguese and English with good verbal communication in Spanish.

This role works very closely with the C level (VP and Director level), influencing the business and translating business objectives into effective people and talent strategies. Will drive and implement global HR initiatives across key Latin American markets and addressing the unique challenges of the region.

This is a strategic and consultancy-focused role, dedicated to high-level partnering.


Key Areas of Accountability & Impact


The Strategic Regional Talent Partner is expected to drive results across three primary domains:


1. Strategic Business Partnership & Consulting


  • Executive Guidance: Serve as the primary HR advisor to senior regional executives, translating complex business objectives into actionable people plans
  • Performance Optimization: Provide expert counsel on maximizing business unit performance
  • Global Integration: Act as the regional conduit, collaborating with global Centers of Expertise (CoE) to ensure global people initiatives are effectively localized and deployed across LATAM markets.


2. Talent Management & Program Execution


  • High-Level Program Support: Directly advise and support senior leaders during critical annual organizational cycles
  • Capability Building: Partner with business leaders to identify and close critical skill gaps
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Facilitate the integration of talent programs across the business streams, working with cross-functional HR teams


3. Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement


  • Process Enhancement: Champion a continuous improvement mindset, actively soliciting feedback from the leadership population to refine HR processes and knowledge resources.
  • Service Model Efficiency: Effectively triage executive requests, leveraging a deep knowledge of the shared services model
  • Knowledge Leadership: Contribute to the overall organizational knowledge base and foster active knowledge sharing across the global HR community.


Required Experience, Skills, & Qualifications


Experience & Educational Foundation

  • Experience: 10+ years of progressive HR experience, with a minimum of 4+ years in a senior HR Business Partnering or strategic advisory role spanning multiple LATAM countries .
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field is highly desired.
  • Context: Proven ability to operate successfully within a complex, matrixed global organization utilizing an HR shared services delivery model.

Critical Competencies

  • Business Acumen: Possesses robust business knowledge (industry trends, competitors, market position)
  • Executive Influence: Exceptional ability to build trust, influence senior leaders (VP/Director), .
  • Bilingual Capability: Fluent English is mandatory. Proficiency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is highly desirable.
  • Agility & Judgment: Demonstrates high levels of resilience, adaptability, and critical thinking to navigate ambiguity, manage high-pressure situations, and exercise sound judgment.
  • Technical Familiarity: Experience with leading HRIS platforms (e.g., Workday ) and service management tools (e.g., ServiceNow ) is preferred.

Other Requirements

  • Flexibility: Willingness to accommodate business needs across different time zones (LATAM and North America).

We're conducting a search for a Strategic Regional Talent Partner with 10+ years of progressive HR experience, an essential and proven focus on the Latin American (LATAM) region, and fluency in Portuguese and English with good verbal communication in Spanish.

This role works very closely with the C level (VP and Director level), influencing the business and translating business objectives into effective people and talent strategies. Will drive and implement global HR initiatives across key Latin American markets and addressing the unique challenges of the region.

This is a strategic and consultancy-focused role, dedicated to high-level partnering.


Key Areas of Accountability & Impact


The Strategic Regional Talent Partner is expected to drive results across three primary domains:


1. Strategic Business Partnership & Consulting


  • Executive Guidance: Serve as the primary HR advisor to senior regional executives, translating complex business objectives into actionable people plans
  • Performance Optimization: Provide expert counsel on maximizing business unit performance
  • Global Integration: Act as the regional conduit, collaborating with global Centers of Expertise (CoE) to ensure global people initiatives are effectively localized and deployed across LATAM markets.


2. Talent Management & Program Execution


  • High-Level Program Support: Directly advise and support senior leaders during critical annual organizational cycles
  • Capability Building: Partner with business leaders to identify and close critical skill gaps
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Facilitate the integration of talent programs across the business streams, working with cross-functional HR teams


3. Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement


  • Process Enhancement: Champion a continuous improvement mindset, actively soliciting feedback from the leadership population to refine HR processes and knowledge resources.
  • Service Model Efficiency: Effectively triage executive requests, leveraging a deep knowledge of the shared services model
  • Knowledge Leadership: Contribute to the overall organizational knowledge base and foster active knowledge sharing across the global HR community.


Required Experience, Skills, & Qualifications


Experience & Educational Foundation

  • Experience: 10+ years of progressive HR experience, with a minimum of 4+ years in a senior HR Business Partnering or strategic advisory role spanning multiple LATAM countries .
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field is highly desired.
  • Context: Proven ability to operate successfully within a complex, matrixed global organization utilizing an HR shared services delivery model.

Critical Competencies

  • Business Acumen: Possesses robust business knowledge (industry trends, competitors, market position)
  • Executive Influence: Exceptional ability to build trust, influence senior leaders (VP/Director), .
  • Bilingual Capability: Fluent English is mandatory. Proficiency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is highly desirable.
  • Agility & Judgment: Demonstrates high levels of resilience, adaptability, and critical thinking to navigate ambiguity, manage high-pressure situations, and exercise sound judgment.
  • Technical Familiarity: Experience with leading HRIS platforms (e.g., Workday ) and service management tools (e.g., ServiceNow ) is preferred.

Other Requirements

  • Flexibility: Willingness to accommodate business needs across different time zones (LATAM and North America).

title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce
description:
Alô Linkedin! Estamos com vagas disponíveis para você na TAAK!


Estamos recrutando um Desenvolvedor Salesforce para integrar nossa equipe na TAAK. Se você tem paixão por programação e deseja trabalhar com uma das plataformas de CRM mais avançadas do mercado, essa vaga é ideal para você!


Desenvolvedor Salesforce (Remoto)


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e customizar aplicações na plataforma Salesforce.
  • Implementar soluções técnicas de alta qualidade para atender às necessidades dos clientes.
  • Colaborar com consultores e arquitetos para desenhar soluções eficientes.
  • Manter-se atualizado com as novas funcionalidades e atualizações da plataforma Salesforce.


Requisitos:

  • Formação em áreas relacionadas à tecnologia, como Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou afins.
  • Conhecimento em alguma linguagem de programação orientada a objetos (Java, C#, etc.).
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento na plataforma Salesforce, incluindo Apex, Visualforce e Lightning Components.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento Apex na plataforma Salesforce (automação, controladores, processos assíncronos)
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de interfaces visuais no Salesforce, utilizando VisualForce Pages, Aura Components, Lightning Web Components (LWC)
  • Experiência com integração de APIs, desenvolvimento de serviços web e API’s padrão Salesforce
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de testes unitários
  • Certificações Salesforce.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento web (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento mobile (Cordova, React Native, Flutter, Kotlin, etc.).
  • Experiência com Lightning Web Components (LWC) para desenvolvimento moderno em Salesforce.
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento mobile utilizando frameworks como Node.js, Cordova, React Native, Flutter, ou Kotlin.
  • Experiência com integração de APIs e serviços web no Salesforce.
  • Familiaridade com DevOps e automação de processos no ambiente Salesforce.
  • Experiência com o desenvolvimento de aplicativos mobile utilizando a Salesforce Mobile SDK.
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança em desenvolvimento Salesforce.
  • Participação em projetos acadêmicos ou pessoais relacionados à tecnologia.
  • Habilidades de resolução de problemas e pensamento crítico.


Benefícios:


️ Vale Refeição (Caju)

Auxílio Home Office (Caju)

title: Profissional Desenvolvedor Java Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 54563


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Mais de 6 anos atuando JAVA, com versões atuais, Springboot e Quarkus;

- Experiência em AWS ( Lambda, S3, CloudFormation, EC2, SQS e RDS);

- Experiência com microsserviços, padrões de projetos modernos, boas práticas de arquitetura dominando conceitos;

- Experiência com Python para desenvolvimento de APIs e automações;

- Atuar profissionalmente com JavaScript e Angular 2+ para aplicações web;

- OCR para extração e leitura de informações em imagens e documentos.

- Docker para padronização e conteinerização de ambiente;

- Experiência em Grafana para monitoramento e análise de métricas;

- Experiência com Langfuse e LangChain para integração e desenvolvimento de soluções com IA generativa;

- Fundamentos de IA, Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Linguagem Natural;

- Fundamentos de Engenharia de Dados (ETL, modelagem e transformação);

- Experiência com RAG.


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior Full Stack Engineer

Reports to: Director of Engineering


Position Overview

The Senior Full Stack Engineer will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining our company’s core business applications. We’re seeking a true systems analyst who thrives on solving complex business challenges and translating them into robust, scalable, and high-performing technical solutions. This individual should be equally comfortable working on both the front-end (React) and back-end (PHP, PostgreSQL, SQL) of modern web applications and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software.


Strong English communication skills are essential for this role, as you’ll be working closely with internal stakeholders, product owners, and developers across global teams. You should be able to clearly articulate technical concepts, document your work effectively, and participate in discussions and code reviews with confidence.


What You Will Do

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The individual in this position will be expected, on a regular basis, to:

  • Design, develop, and maintain back-end functionality for enterprise-level business applications using PHP and PostgreSQL .
  • Build and enhance interactive, responsive front-end interfaces using React and modern JavaScript frameworks.
  • Collaborate with other engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to enhance our company’s product line and ensure optimal system performance.
  • Write clean, well-structured, and well-tested code following best practices and coding standards.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize applications for speed, scalability, and reliability.
  • Participate in architectural discussions and help define technical direction for new features and system improvements.
  • Stay up to date with the latest trends and technologies in full stack development, contributing ideas for process and tool improvements.
  • Mentor, guide, and provide technical support to junior developers and team members.
  • Communicate effectively with non-technical teams and management to explain technical solutions in a clear, professional manner.
  • Prepare and maintain detailed technical documentation to ensure knowledge sharing and long-term maintainability of code.


What You Will Bring

  • Proven ability to write clean, well-documented, and well-tested code (samples may be requested).
  • Strong understanding of PHP , PostgreSQL , and SQL , with hands-on experience in designing, optimizing, and maintaining relational databases.
  • Proficiency with React or other modern front-end frameworks for building scalable, interactive web interfaces.
  • Experience with object-oriented programming (OOP) principles and design patterns.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Strong attention to detail and a passion for delivering high-quality, reliable software.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills , with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with experience working in agile, team-based environments .
  • Experience in the logistics, supply chain, or transportation industry is a plus.
  • Enjoys documenting code and processes, sharing knowledge, and continuously improving both personal and team skills.
  • Comfortable working in a remote, fast-paced, and globally distributed environment .


Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in full stack development, including both back-end and front-end technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with PHP, PostgreSQL, SQL, and React in production environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex projects from conception to deployment.
  • Strong understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC) principles and agile methodologies .
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

title: Senior Infrastructure Linux Engineer (L2 | Production | Market Data | Remote | Brazil)
description:
IMPORTANT: Eligible location is Brazil


Company Description


Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm with a global footprint, bringing together diverse talents from various backgrounds to deliver innovative solutions to clients worldwide. We are committed to excellence, collaboration, and consistently exceeding performance expectations across a wide range of industries.


Role Description


We are looking for a skilled Senior Linux infrastructure engineer to maintain and enhance the real-time data systems powering one of the world’s leading investment banks as our customer. You will handle alert and incident management, problem resolution, and system improvements, ensuring uptime and performance for global trading and data services.managing and resolving infrastructure issues and ensuring optimal performance of real-time data services.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Resolving Data quality issues, this includes root cause analysis while managing internal and external vendors to resolve Data issues.
  • Support On-call, incident management, problem and change managements.
  • Ensuring optimal accuracy and timeliness of Data on a real-time basis while implementing monitoring tools to detect data issues.
  • Work closely with regional and global Market Data Infrastructure teams to share knowledge and experience to enrich the team's capability and work together to provide a high level quality of services on Market Data.
  • L2 Alert Management. Management of alerts that require knowledge for resolutions, creating and/or updating resolutions into knowledge base, run books, scripts and ITRS rules where possible
  • Incident Management. Managing of incident lifecycle from identification to resolution, ensuring mitigation of business impact in the production environment.
  • Change Management. Management of the process of making production changes to the ticker plant like Mandatory updates which includes content, software changes/upgrades that are performed by vendors or internal teams where only checkouts are necessary.
  • Others: Release Management, Event Management, User support, Reporting.


What We're Looking For?

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in infrastructure, systems, or production support roles
  • Highly skilled in Linux System Administration
  • Experience in Windows operating systems
  • Scripting proficiency (Bash and/or Python preferred)
  • Experience with networking and connectivity skills e.g. multicast , routing, switches, TCP/IP.
  • Good communication and oral and written English skills is a must
  • Understanding of ITIL Foundation and IT Best practices
  • Prior experience in banking, investment, or other financial IT environments is advantageous
  • Skills which are not mandatory but are advantage:


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with ITRS Geneos , EXEGY (Wombat/Vela) , or Market Data platforms (Refinitiv TREP/RTDS, Bloomberg)
  • Familiarity with AWS ECS , AWS VPC , Google Cloud
  • Experience with GitHub/GitLab and automation pipelines


What We Offer?

  • A modern, dynamic, and future-oriented environment within a top global institution
  • Flexible working arrangements – fully remote or hybrid options
  • Continuous learning and certification opportunities
  • Competitive salary and benefits packagr
  • Long-term career prospects with international exposure
  • Inclusive, multicultural team with regular knowledge-sharing and team events

title: Analista de infraestrutura
description:
Descrição da vaga

Sobre nós:

A Penso Tecnologia é uma empresa de serviços de TI criada para possibilitar que os clientes utilizem a tecnologia a favor de seus negócios. Estamos alinhados a tecnologias globais para expandir o negócio de nossos clientes. Em nosso portifólio contamos com soluções de atuação on-premises e soluções de cloud computing.

A Penso está em franco crescimento e estamos à procura de talentos que estejam dispostos a novos desafios e crescimento.


SONHAMOS GRANDE:

Nos próximos anos esperamos crescer consideravelmente e nos tornarmos uma das maiores suítes corporativas do Brasil.


Como é trabalhar com a gente?

Aqui você vai encontrar um ambiente descontraído, com intensa troca de conhecimento e estrutura horizontal de hierarquia, além de um bom portfólio de produtos e serviços.

Nosso clima é alegre, descontraído e de intensa colaboração!


O Foco dessa área é prestar atendimento e suporte de alta complexidade com excelência, provendo soluções eficazes visando o melhor resultado possível em ações preventivas, reativas e emergenciais.


Sobre a área de suporte avançado:

Esta é uma posição de nível Sênior.

O suporte de N3 (nível 3) trata demandas que foram escalonadas pelos níveis 1 e 2.

O Foco dessa área é prestar atendimento e suporte de alta complexidade com excelência, provendo soluções eficazes visando o melhor resultado possível em ações preventivas, reativas e emergenciais.


Qual será a sua missão com a Penso?

  • Ser a imagem da Penso para os clientes transmitindo segurança, clareza, objetividade e transparência;
  • Disponibilidade total quando estiver de plantão;
  • Atender pronta e corretamente as solicitações registrando e solucionando conforme procedimento técnicos;
  • Manter-se atualizado, lendo procedimentos operacionais, treinamentos, certificações e outros;
  • Promover a disseminação do conhecimento através das interações com o time;
  • Interagir com outros analistas para resolução, tratativa e acompanhamento das solicitações;
  • Identificar atividades que deveriam ser automatizadas e escrever ou propor ferramentas para automatizá-las;
  • Proteger os dados da Penso e do cliente contra falhas humanas e tecnológicas.


Para dar match com a gente você tem de:

  • Ser excelente com as palavras. Nesse cargo você irá prestar suporte remoto!
  • Curioso, ir além do óbvio e propor soluções criativas que ainda não enxergamos!
  • Organizado e responsável;
  • Exercer comunicação assertiva e entender como influenciar pessoas positivamente!
  • Requisitos e qualificações


O que esperamos que você traga de bagagem?

  • Conhecimentos específicos focados em troubleshooting e resolução de problemas em ambientes híbridos (Cloud/MultiCloud/On-Premise) que retratem:
  • Vivência em Servidores Windows/Linux WebServer
  • Serviços como AD, DHCP, DNS, GPO, WDS, WSUS, IIS, Shadowcopy, configuração de permissões NTFS;
  • Realizar tarefas relacionadas à instalação, configuração e administração de Redes;
  • Domínio sobre conceitos de Firewall (SonicWall, Fortigate, PFSense entre outros), como Regras, VPN SSL e IPSec;


Serão diferenciais:

  • Habilidades práticas em Virtualização (VMWare; Hyper-V e afins).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de Backup como Windows Server Backup, Veaam Backup & Replication, Cobian, rotinas de testes e restauração.
  • Gestão de servidores de e-mail Zimbra, Exchange, Postfix e outros;
  • Certificações Correlatas.

A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.

Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

-Angular

- ASP .NET

- lambda

- Linguagem C#

- .NET

- VB6

- Oracle BD

- NOSQL: REDIS

- .NET VB

  • - MESSAGING (KAFKA, SQS, SNS)

Responsabilidade

O Desenvolvedor Full Stack tem uma missão de implementar novos sistemas e dar sustentação nos sistemas já existentes, fazer entregas com qualidade, segurança e alta performance, colaborar com o time, motivar positivamente o ambiente, lidar com a pressão por entregas das áreas demandantes e clientes externos. - Proporcionar junto com o time soluções técnicas eficientes, flexíveis e que atendem ao negócio,

- Estar atualizado em relação às novas práticas e tecnologias,


MODELO: Remoto, CLT


E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Escalation Manager
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
Job Description
Your Career
The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and/or sales opportunities with key customers.
The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.
In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.
Your Impact
  • Escalation Leadership
    • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
    • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
    • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
    • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
    • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
    • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
    • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
    • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
    • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
    • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
    • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
    • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
    • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
    • A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
    • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
    • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process/system/product
    • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and/or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
    • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
    • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
    • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • Fully fluent in Portuguese, English, and Spanish both written and verbal
  • Customer Experience
    • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and/or service delivery roles
    • Past experience as Escalations Engineer/Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
    • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators
  • Program/Project management
    • Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues
    • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer
    • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA/SLO/Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
    • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
    • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
    • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
    • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
    • Experience with Networking/Security Products
    • Knowledge of LAN/WAN technologies, encompassing general routing/switching/security for both branch and data center architectures
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales teams, and other invested parties
  • Creative thinking, adaptability, and versatility
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and/or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues
Additional Information
The Team
The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.
Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making
As Escalation Managers, each team member will be at the vanguard of our dedication to cybersecurity. Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. This role demands proactivity, efficiency, an unwavering dedication to constant refinement, and a passion for customer satisfaction.
Driving continuous learnings and efficiency into the Escalation Management and Product Lifecycle is one of the key areas for the team as we continue our focus on customer experience.
Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

    • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA/SLO/Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
    • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
    • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
    • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
    • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
    • Experience with Networking/Security Products
    • Knowledge of LAN/WAN technologies, encompassing general routing/switching/security for both branch and data center architectures
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales teams, and other invested parties
  • Creative thinking, adaptability, and versatility
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and/or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues
Additional Information
The Team
The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.
Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making
As Escalation Managers, each team member will be at the vanguard of our dedication to cybersecurity. Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. This role demands proactivity, efficiency, an unwavering dedication to constant refinement, and a passion for customer satisfaction.
Driving continuous learnings and efficiency into the Escalation Management and Product Lifecycle is one of the key areas for the team as we continue our focus on customer experience.
Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Angular Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Angular Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Develop, code, test, and debug application programs of varying degree of complexity.

- Code user interfaces with the latest frontend technologies

- Work with business users to develop and implement acceptance tests to ensure that product meets customer requirements and expectations.

- Ensure high performance of all systems developed.


Requirements:


- 4+ years of experience working as a developer.

- 2+ years of experience in Angular 2+.

- Experience in developing applications using Angular/Java technology stack.

- Solid experience with HTML, CSS, and writing cross-browser compatible code.

- Strong knowledge of AJAX and JavaScript Dom manipulation Techniques.

- Experience with MSSQL and/or PostgresSQL

- Experience with React is a plus.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

Com escritórios no Brasil, Estados Unidos, México e Portugal, contabiliza mais de 1 milhão de fornecedores, 10 mil compradores e transaciona um valor acima de R$ 160 bilhões em negócios anualmente.   • Criar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, sustentáveis e orientadas ao negócio;
  • Participar ativamente na elaboração das soluções;
  • Atuar em um ambiente desafiador e inspirador;
  • Colaborar com outras equipes, como UX/UI, QA e DevOps, para garantir uma entrega integrada e alinhada;


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Sólidos conhecimentos com a plataforma Java: Maven, Spring Framework (Spring MVC, Spring Security) e JPA
  • Bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis, Neo4j e ElasticSearch);

Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei profissional da área de desenvovlimento venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um(a/e) #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


- Experiência mínima de 2 anos em desenvolvimento frontend, com foco em React Native para aplicativos mobile.

* Forte conhecimento em TypeScript e JavaScript.

* Experiência prática com bibliotecas de gerenciamento de estado em apps móveis, especialmente Redux.

* Conhecimento em Firebase (Analytics, Crashlytics, Remote Config).

* Vivência com CI/CD para distribuição e deploy de aplicativos móveis.

* Domínio em controle de versão utilizando Git e aplicação de boas práticas em versionamento.

* Experiência em testes automatizados com Jest.


Desejável: * Familiaridade com ferramentas de documentação de API, como Swagger.

* Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e boas práticas de gestão de projetos. Tecnologias e Ferramentas que você irá utilizar:

* Backend: NestJS e Node.js

* Frontend Mobile: React Native

* Cloud: AWS (SQS, S3)

* Firebase (Analytics, Crashlytics, Remote Config)

* Linguagens: TypeScript e JavaScript

* Versionamento: Git


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Instrutor MQ Series
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Instrutor MQ Series


Estamos buscando um **Instrutor especializado em IBM MQ** para ministrar curso voltado para desenvolvedores, com foco em integração de sistemas mainframe e aplicações modernas. O profissional será responsável por capacitar equipes de desenvolvimento em tecnologias de mensageria corporativa, COBOL e boas práticas de integração.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS

Ensino e Treinamento

  • Ministrar cursos remotos sobre IBM MQ para desenvolvedores
  • Desenvolver e atualizar material didático (apresentações, exercícios práticos, documentação)
  • Criar cenários de simulação e laboratórios práticos
  • Avaliar o progresso dos alunos e fornecer feedback construtivo
  • Adaptar o conteúdo conforme o nível técnico da turma

Desenvolvimento de Conteúdo

  • Elaborar guias de melhores práticas para IBM MQ
  • Criar exemplos práticos de integração COBOL + IBM MQ
  • Desenvolver casos de uso reais para exercícios
  • Manter documentação técnica atualizada
  • Produzir material de apoio (manuais, quick references, troubleshooting guides)

Suporte Técnico

  • Auxiliar desenvolvedores na resolução de problemas técnicos
  • Fornecer consultoria em arquitetura de soluções com IBM MQ
  • Apoiar na implementação de boas práticas de desenvolvimento
  • Realizar code reviews e orientações técnicas

REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS

Experiência Técnica

  • Mínimo 5 anos** de experiência com IBM MQ (WebSphere MQ)
  • Experiência sólida** em desenvolvimento COBOL
  • Conhecimento em **ambientes mainframe** (z/OS, CICS, DB2)
  • Experiência com **integração de sistemas** e arquiteturas SOA/ESB
  • Conhecimento em **JCL, copybooks** e estruturas de dados mainframe

Experiência em Ensino

  • Mínimo 2 anos** ministrando treinamentos técnicos
  • Experiência com **desenvolvimento de material didático**
  • Habilidade para explicar conceitos técnicos complexos de forma clara

Competências Técnicas Específicas

  • Configuração e administração de Queue Managers**
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações que utilizam MQGET, MQPUT, MQOPEN, MQCLOSE**
  • Conhecimento em MQ Channels, Queues, Topics**
  • Experiência com MQ Explorer** e ferramentas de monitoramento
  • Troubleshooting de problemas de conectividade e performance
  • Conhecimento em MQ Security** (SSL/TLS, autenticação, autorização)

Soft Skills

  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita
  • Paciência e didática para ensinar
  • Capacidade de adaptação a diferentes perfis de alunos
  • Proatividade na resolução de problemas
  • Trabalho em equipe e colaboração

REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS

Certificações

  • IBM Certified Solution Developer - WebSphere MQ



Formação Acadêmica


  • Graduação completa.

description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Instrutor MQ Series


Estamos buscando um **Instrutor especializado em IBM MQ** para ministrar curso voltado para desenvolvedores, com foco em integração de sistemas mainframe e aplicações modernas. O profissional será responsável por capacitar equipes de desenvolvimento em tecnologias de mensageria corporativa, COBOL e boas práticas de integração.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS

Ensino e Treinamento

  • Ministrar cursos remotos sobre IBM MQ para desenvolvedores
  • Desenvolver e atualizar material didático (apresentações, exercícios práticos, documentação)
  • Criar cenários de simulação e laboratórios práticos
  • Avaliar o progresso dos alunos e fornecer feedback construtivo
  • Adaptar o conteúdo conforme o nível técnico da turma

Desenvolvimento de Conteúdo

  • Elaborar guias de melhores práticas para IBM MQ
  • Criar exemplos práticos de integração COBOL + IBM MQ
  • Desenvolver casos de uso reais para exercícios
  • Manter documentação técnica atualizada
  • Produzir material de apoio (manuais, quick references, troubleshooting guides)

Suporte Técnico

  • Auxiliar desenvolvedores na resolução de problemas técnicos
  • Fornecer consultoria em arquitetura de soluções com IBM MQ
  • Apoiar na implementação de boas práticas de desenvolvimento
  • Realizar code reviews e orientações técnicas

REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS

Experiência Técnica

  • Mínimo 5 anos** de experiência com IBM MQ (WebSphere MQ)
  • Experiência sólida** em desenvolvimento COBOL
  • Conhecimento em **ambientes mainframe** (z/OS, CICS, DB2)
  • Experiência com **integração de sistemas** e arquiteturas SOA/ESB
  • Conhecimento em **JCL, copybooks** e estruturas de dados mainframe

Experiência em Ensino

  • Mínimo 2 anos** ministrando treinamentos técnicos
  • Experiência com **desenvolvimento de material didático**
  • Habilidade para explicar conceitos técnicos complexos de forma clara

Competências Técnicas Específicas

  • Configuração e administração de Queue Managers**
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações que utilizam MQGET, MQPUT, MQOPEN, MQCLOSE**
  • Conhecimento em MQ Channels, Queues, Topics**
  • Experiência com MQ Explorer** e ferramentas de monitoramento
  • Troubleshooting de problemas de conectividade e performance
  • Conhecimento em MQ Security** (SSL/TLS, autenticação, autorização)

Soft Skills

  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita
  • Paciência e didática para ensinar
  • Capacidade de adaptação a diferentes perfis de alunos
  • Proatividade na resolução de problemas
  • Trabalho em equipe e colaboração

REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS

Certificações

  • IBM Certified Solution Developer - WebSphere MQ



Formação Acadêmica


  • Graduação completa.

PJ


Todas as nossas oportunidades de trabalho estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Tech Lead | Data Engineering
description:
✨ Seu talento impulsiona o nosso futuro

A Getnet é uma empresa global de tecnologia especializada em soluções de pagamento para o comércio. Fundada no Brasil e presente na América Latina e na Península Ibérica, apoiamos mais de 1,3 milhão de comerciantes com serviços completos — da maquininha ao e-commerce.

Fazemos parte da PagoNxt , a fintech global do Grupo Santander, e atuamos como um hub de adquirência com forte presença em Espanha, Portugal, Brasil, México, Chile, Argentina e Uruguai .

Nossa missão é clara: simplificar os pagamentos com inovação, segurança e escala , ajudando negócios de todos os tamanhos a crescer com agilidade.

Oferecemos uma plataforma unificada que integra hardware, software, prevenção à fraude, adquirência, conciliação e serviços financeiros — tudo em um só ecossistema, para que nossos clientes possam focar no crescimento do seu negócio.

Fazer parte da Getnet é se juntar a uma empresa que combina a inovação de uma fintech com a solidez de um banco global.

Imagine your future. Care for your career. Simplify your journey.

Isso significa que você terá a chance de construir soluções de impacto, crescer com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e evoluir em uma cultura que valoriza bem-estar, inclusão e clareza.

Combinamos flexibilidade, autonomia e colaboração global — para que você possa focar no que importa, se conectar com propósito e ajudar a moldar o futuro.

Aqui, você vai encontrar espaço para crescer, oportunidades reais para liderar e uma cultura onde todas as pessoas pertencem e contribuem.

✨ Se você quer fazer parte da próxima geração de soluções financeiras, este é o lugar certo.

Já te imagina sendo Nxter?


Na Getnet, estamos buscando uma pessoa para a vaga de Tech Lead - Data Engineering para se juntar ao nosso time em Data Plataform.


O que você vai fazer

Como Tech Lead de Data Engineering, você será a referência técnica em nossa infraestrutura de Data Platform, liderando iniciativas relacionadas à gestão de dados de interação com nossos clientes, incluindo a elaboração de demonstrativos de vendas e extratos. Terá papel fundamental na Transformação Tecnológica, apoiando a transição de sistemas legados (Oracle, PL SQL, OpenShift) para tecnologias modernas (Spark/Scala, SQL, Databricks, Atlas, Kubernetes), garantindo a continuidade dos negócios e a minimização de riscos.


  • Você será referência Técnica: Atuando como especialista técnico, orientando o time de engenharia em boas práticas, arquitetura e decisões estratégicas de tecnologia.
  • Colaboração com Stakeholders: Trabalhar próximo a times de produto, tecnologia e negócio para entender necessidades e traduzir em soluções eficazes.
  • Evolução Tecnológica: Apoiar a modernização de sistemas e migração para ambientes em nuvem, garantindo segurança, escalabilidade e desempenho.
  • Integração de Sistemas: Projetar e apoiar integrações de novos sistemas com a infraestrutura existente, assegurando eficiência operacional.
  • Cultura de Inovação: Promover boas práticas de engenharia, cultura de colaboração e aprendizado contínuo no time.
  • Conciliação de Informações: Apoiar a construção de soluções para conciliações de pequenos, médios e grandes comércios, além de fluxos regulatórios (bandeiras, BACEN, etc.).


✅ O que buscamos em você

  • Experiência em Arquitetura de Software: Sólido conhecimento em padrões de arquitetura, engenharia de software e data engineering.
  • Gestão de Riscos Técnicos: Capacidade de identificar riscos em soluções e propor alternativas.
  • Vivência técnica com: ORACLE, PL SQL, SQL, JAVA, DATABRICKS, SPARK/SCALA;
  • Kubernetes e Cloud (AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud);
  • APIs e Integrações: atuação em Integração de Sistemas: Capacidade de projetar e validar soluções interoperáveis em ambientes complexos.


✅ O que pode contar pontos a mais

  • Experiência em empresas de adquirência ou tecnologia.
  • Familiaridade com fluxo de extrato financeiro.
  • Atuação anterior como Tech Lead ou Especialista Técnico em projetos de modernização de plataformas de dados.


O que oferecemos

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
About the job


At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We are a leading end-to-end development consultancy for digital transformation across various markets, growing sustainably since day one. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.



About the Opportunity


We are seeking a Engineer to join our high-performing engineering team, focused on building highly available, large-scale, and low-latency data platforms . This role is ideal for a hands-on, experienced engineer who can immediately contribute to solving complex challenges, driving technical excellence, and enhancing our DevOps and backend infrastructure.

You’ll join a collaborative, empowered, and agile team responsible for enterprise data distribution applications and backend APIs that serve external customers worldwide, including international markets such as Canada and Japan . This position offers the opportunity to take ownership of critical DevOps operations, design scalable solutions, and continuously evolve our platform’s reliability, performance, and security.


Responsibilities


  • Design, build, and maintain highly available and scalable backend systems and APIs.
  • Lead and own DevOps initiatives , including CI/CD pipeline management, cloud infrastructure, and container orchestration.
  • Implement and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform , ensuring secure, reproducible, and automated deployments.
  • Work closely with stakeholders, product owners, and cross-functional teams to deliver new features and improve existing systems .
  • Ensure disaster recovery readiness and compliance with security best practices .
  • Manage and optimize AWS services (S3, RDS, EventBridge, SQS, IAM, VPC, ECR, etc.).
  • Deploy and manage Kubernetes (EKS) clusters and Docker images in production environments.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across distributed systems and drive root cause analysis.
  • Maintain high standards of code quality, testing, and documentation .
  • Collaborate across engineering teams (Platform, Security, UX) to ensure seamless integration and delivery.


Required Qualifications


  • 8+ years of professional experience in functional programming , with Node.js / JavaScript (not TypeScript).
  • Proven experience with DevOps practices and cloud-native environments .
  • Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS) and Docker .
  • Expertise with AWS (S3, RDS, EventBridge, SQS, DMS, Security Groups, IAM, VPCs, ECR).
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with relational databases (MSSQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Aurora, RDS).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows.
  • Familiarity with Terraform (infrastructure as code).
  • Solid understanding of application security and use of security tools (e.g., Wiz, Snyk ).
  • Strong debugging, issue resolution, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in an agile environment.
  • Pragmatic mindset with a strong sense of ownership and craftsmanship .


Nice to Have Skills


  • Experience with automated database migrations and versioning.
  • Background in API integration and distribution systems .
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Exposure to multi-region cloud deployments .
  • Previous experience supporting regulated industries or compliance-driven environments.
  • Passion for mentoring team members and driving engineering best practices.



Avenue Code ensures the privacy of all candidates in compliance with regulations such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA, and CPRA. The data will be used solely for recruitment processes and may be shared, in a limited manner, with clients and CompassUOL Group companies when necessary to provide services.

title: Business Systems Analyst
description:
Onebridge, a Marlabs Company, is a global AI and Data Analytics Consulting Firm that empowers organizations worldwide to drive better outcomes through data and technology. Since 2005, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government entities across the globe. We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Business Systems Analyst to join our innovative and dynamic team.


Employment Type: Contract

Location: Remote - Brazil

Industry: IT & Services, Data & Analytics.


Business Systems Analyst | About You

As a Business Systems Analyst, you are responsible for supporting the success of a Pay-Per-Use program by identifying, triaging, and resolving data and process discrepancies tied to financial operations. You bring a strong analytical mindset, an understanding of how data flows across systems, and the ability to work cross-functionally across technical and business teams. You’re comfortable navigating reporting systems, investigating issues, and ensuring data accuracy that supports key financial processes such as billing and revenue recognition. While you don’t interact directly with external clients, your work plays a critical role in maintaining operational efficiency and enabling clean financial outcomes. You are detail-oriented, naturally curious, and confident working independently to drive resolution in a fast-paced environment.


Business Systems Analyst | Day-to-Day

  • Triage and resolve data issues within the Pay-Per-Use program by identifying root causes and directing them to the appropriate teams.
  • Maintain and manage the team’s Jira board, including issue tracking, documentation, and validation of outcomes.
  • Troubleshoot and update Tableau reports (10–15 dashboards), ensuring accuracy and relevance of the displayed data.
  • Write and modify SQL queries to investigate issues, validate fixes, and extract data as needed.
  • Collaborate closely with internal finance, technical, and business stakeholders to support billing and revenue-related processes.
  • Contribute to chatbot proof-of-concept development by providing data insights and supporting testing activities.


Business Systems Analyst | Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst, or similar analytical role.
  • Proficient in writing SQL queries for data investigation and analysis.
  • Hands-on experience modifying and troubleshooting Tableau dashboards and working with backend data sources.
  • Skilled in managing issues in Jira and working across business and technical teams.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Familiarity with navigating Salesforce and SAP for data verification (no development or admin experience required).

title: TECH LEAD - TIME DESENVOLVIMENTO, REMOTO
description:
Somos o grupo educacional mais diversificado do país. Todos os dias, criamos futuros incríveis através da inovação. Colocamos a mão na massa para tirar as ideias do papel e colocá-las em prática. Enfrentamos desafios com resiliência e nos adaptamos às mudanças constantes.


Por aqui, somos um time e não heróis, guiados pela vontade de fazer a diferença e conectados de um só jeito, o #JeitoCogna. Nossa relação é direta e respeitosa, e o sucesso dos nossos alunos e clientes é o nosso sucesso.


Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:

- Liderar tecnicamente equipes de desenvolvimento ágil, garantindo a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade, escaláveis e alinhadas às metas de negócio.

- Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de sistemas, promovendo boas práticas de engenharia de software, segurança da informação, automação e observabilidade.

- Atuar como facilitador entre áreas técnicas e de negócio, traduzindo necessidades estratégicas em soluções tecnológicas eficientes.

- Conduzir o planejamento e acompanhamento de projetos, assegurando prazos, custos, indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e qualidade das entregas.

- Implementar padrões de governança técnica, versionamento, testes automatizados, CI/CD e monitoramento contínuo de performance.

- Apoiar o crescimento técnico do time por meio de mentorias, feedbacks estruturados e planos de desenvolvimento individual.

- Fomentar uma cultura de colaboração, aprendizado contínuo, inovação e melhoria constante nos processos de desenvolvimento.

- Participar ativamente de decisões estratégicas sobre tecnologias, ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento que impactem a arquitetura corporativa.

- Promover o uso racional de recursos em nuvem, garantindo eficiência operacional, segurança e sustentabilidade financeira.

- Atuar na mitigação de riscos técnicos e na resolução de incidentes críticos, com foco em análise de causa raiz e prevenção.



Requisitos e qualificações:

- Experiência comprovada em Engenharia de Software, Arquitetura de Sistemas e Liderança Técnica de equipes ágeis de alta performance.

- Domínio técnico em:

- Arquitetura de microserviços e integração de sistemas distribuídos

- Cloud Computing (preferencialmente AWS, Azure ou GCP)

- Banco de dados relacionais e não relacionais

- Mensageria e streaming de dados (ex: Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ)

- APIs RESTful, GraphQL e boas práticas de versionamento

- Ferramentas de CI/CD, containers (Docker, Kubernetes) e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK)

- Forte conhecimento em metodologias Agile/Scrum/Kanban, gestão de backlog e métricas de produtividade técnica (lead time, throughput, qualidade de código).

- Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

- Certificações desejáveis: Scrum Master, AWS Solutions Architect, DevOps, Cloud Practitioner ou similares.

- Excelentes habilidades de liderança, comunicação assertiva, gestão de conflitos, visão sistêmica e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.

- Perfil hands-on, com capacidade de atuar estrategicamente e operacionalmente quando necessário.

- Proatividade, curiosidade tecnológica e capacidade de inspirar e engajar pessoas em torno de objetivos comuns.



O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.


Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.



Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!
